regests.text: Vor König Friedrich (coram rege Friderico) wird der Streit zwischen Eufemia, der Witwe Heinrichs von Hegilen, und dem Stift Berchtesgaden unter Propst Heinrich um Saline und Salzpfanne zu Reichenhall nach dem Zeugnis der Edelfreien Otto von Moos, Erbo von Biburg und Herbord von Hebingen durch Spruch des erwählten Richters Markgraf Engelbert von Kraiburg (Istrien) zugunsten des Stiftes entschieden. commentary.t: Wibald von Stablo berichtet in seinem Schreiben an Papst Eugen III. aus dem Jahre 1152 (Reg.
) über das Alter des neuen Königs:
nondum ut credimus annorum triginta

. Dieser Angabe folgte Simonsfeld, Jahrbücher 2 f.; Hofmeister, Puer, iuvenis, senex (FS. P. Kehr zum 65. Geb., 1926) 287 ff. trat nach einer Untersuchung der mittelalterlichen Altersbezeichnungen und gemäß einigen Angaben im Ligurinus für April 1124-Oktober 1130 (etwa 1125/26?) als Zeitpunkt der Geburt Friedrichs ein. Dagegen erklärte sich wieder Grundmann, Cappenberger Barbarossakopf (Münstersche Forschungen 12, 1959) 27 ff. mit guten Gründen für das Jahr 1122, eine Ansicht, der auch Heimpel, NDB 5 (1961) 459 folgte. - Zur weiteren Eingrenzung des Zeitraumes, in dem die Geburt Barbarossas erfolgte, vgl. jetzt Opll, Winterquatember, MIÖG 85 (1977) 332 ff. - Als Geburtsort gibt Tholomeus v. Lucca, Hist. eccl. nova c. 21, Rer. Ital. SS XI (1727) 1104, eine durchaus sekundäre Quelle, unter Berufung auf die Gesta Germanorum et Francorum und auf Vinzenz von Beauvais die Stammburg des Geschlechtes, den Hohenstaufen, an.

transmission.t: Ottonis Gesta Frid. l. I cap. 14, ed. Waitz-Simson, MG. SS rer. Germ. in us. schol. 30. Zu Geburt und Taufe Friedrich Barbarossas vgl. zuletzt

, in: Frühmittelalterliche Studien 46 (2012), 241‒299, insbesondere 254‒271, die beachtenswerte Argumente für die Datierung der Taufe auf den Johannestag am 27. Dezember sowie für Hagenau als Ort von Geburt und Taufe des Staufers beibringt.

gaps.text: The 'Vergleich zwischen dem Bischof von Basel und dem Kloster St. Blasien' (DK. III. 57) is a legal act, but the act scheme has no settlement or agreement type; rv:Dispute or rv:Judgment would assert a contest or a sentence the regest does not state. Not extracted.

findings.description: The settlement between the bishop of Basel and St. Blasien is a legal relation stated by the regest and is in scope. The contract has no settlement type; rv:Dispute would only be acceptable with the exact word 'Vergleich' as qualifier and the two parties as rv:Participant, since a dispute is implied rather than stated. The omission was not reported as a gap in the candidate file.
findings.proposal: Either add an ActFactoid of type rv:Dispute with rf:qualifier 'Vergleich', references to the bishop (urn:regesta:actor:RI004-002-O000272, name in source 'Bischof von Basel', rv:Participant) and the monastery (urn:regesta:actor:RI004-002-B000974:community, typed crm:E74_Group, name in source 'Kloster St. Blasien', rv:Participant), or record the settlement explicitly as a model gap.

decisions.finding: The settlement 'einem Vergleich zwischen dem Bischof von Basel und dem Kloster St. Blasien' is omitted; proposed as rv:Dispute with qualifier 'Vergleich' and two rv:Participant references, or as a model gap.
decisions.reason: The passage characterises the charter DK. III. 57 as a 'Vergleich', an agreement, and states no dispute. rv:Dispute is 'Ein Streit oder eine Klage vor einem Gericht oder Herrscher' and rv:Judgment a 'Spruch'; typing the settlement as a dispute with a qualifier would infer a dispute the passage does not state and turn a model limit into a different meaning. The vocabulary has no type for a settlement or agreement.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22640:consent
findings.description: A consent to a foundation is typed rv:Confirmation. The vocabulary defines a confirmation as confirming possession, rights or an earlier act; the regest reports consent to an Errichtung, not the confirmation of an existing state or prior act. Querying confirmations would wrongly include this record. The extractor marked the choice as nearest type, and the qualifier "Zustimmung" preserves the wording, so the defect is partly mitigated.
findings.proposal: Keep the factoid with qualifier "Zustimmung" but flag the type as provisional, or add a consent act type to the vocabulary in a later contract revision; until then rv:Confirmation should be listed as a known misfit in the batch report.

decisions.finding: A consent (Zustimmung) to the foundation of Lochgarten is typed rv:Confirmation; the founders Konstantin and Giselbert carry rv:Beneficiary.
decisions.reason: The passage reads 'seine Zustimmung zur Errichtung des Frauenstiftes Lochgarten durch die Untertanen von Lorch, Konstantin und Giselbert'. rv:Confirmation is defined as confirming 'Besitz, Rechte oder einen früheren Akt', and the guidelines model a confirmation as two act factoids joined by rf:refersToAct; the regest reports no earlier act or existing right that is confirmed, only consent to an act of others. The vocabulary has no consent type and no generic act type, so the current typing turns a model limit into a different historical meaning, which correct.md forbids, and the qualifier 'Zustimmung' does not undo the false membership in queries for confirmations. Reclassifying under another type would be a new reading. The only safe fix is removal with a recorded gap. The Vogtei holding and the parenthood factoid of the same passage are supported and stay.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22645:parenthood-friedrich
findings.description: After "zwingt diesen" the possessive "seinem" can grammatically refer to Herzog Konrad as well as to Friedrich. The Child reference to Friedrich is anchored by a second selector "Friedrich dringt", which names Friedrich but does not establish that he is the possessor. The decisive disambiguation comes from the register labels ("Vater Friedrich Barbarossas", "Onkel Friedrich Barbarossas"), which the guidelines admit only for identification, not as facts. The same applies to urn:regesta:22645:kinship-oheim. The reading is very probably right, and the extractor flagged it, but the factoids state more than the passage alone secures.
findings.proposal: Keep both factoids but mark the antecedent ambiguity for expert review (for example in the batch report or a reviewer annotation), or replace the 'Friedrich dringt' selector by stating the reliance on the identification explicitly; do not treat the factoids as resting on the passage alone.

findings.description: The regest states that the conquered castle belongs to the duke ("Burg des Herzogs", also "dessen Stammburg"). This is a possession relation, which the guidelines keep in scope even inside a military passage, and rv:Possession with Herzog Konrad as Possessor could express it with exact wording. It is not recorded.
findings.proposal: Add a StateFactoid of type rv:Possession with a reference to RI004-002-K000398 as rv:Possessor (nameInSource "Herzogs" or via the Fehde passage) and rf:concerns a crm:E18_Physical_Thing labelled "Burg des Herzogs"; optionally a second one for "Stammburg".

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22645:request-peace
findings.description: Friedrich is recorded as rv:Participant for compelling the request. This is the honest fallback, but Participant blurs that he is the coercing opponent, not a party to the request.
findings.proposal: Acceptable under the current vocabulary; record the coercing-party role as a model gap.

decisions.finding: The possessive 'seinem' after 'zwingt diesen' is grammatically ambiguous between Friedrich and Herzog Konrad; the Child and Kin references to Friedrich rest on a reading the passage alone does not secure.
decisions.reason: The ambiguity is real in 'zwingt diesen, vor seinem Vater (Friedrich von Schwaben) und seinem Oheim (König Konrad III.) zu erscheinen', but Friedrich is the grammatical subject of the whole regest, the parenthetical names identify the father and uncle by name and title with the packet candidates RI004-002-F000681 and RI004-002-K000316, and the extractor declared the reading as an unresolved identity in batch-5 and in a Turtle comment. The contract has no property to mark a contested antecedent inside the graph, and removing both factoids would discard a defensible reading. The ambiguity stays open for expert review through the batch report; a factoid records the producer's reading, not a fact.

decisions.finding: 'Burg des Herzogs' and 'dessen Stammburg' state a possession of Herzog Konrad that should be added as an rv:Possession state factoid.
decisions.reason: In 'erobert eine für uneinnehmbar geltende Burg des Herzogs' and 'bis zu dessen Stammburg vor' the genitive and the possessive identify the targets of an advance and a conquest, which the guidelines exclude as military action. They are attributes of an out-of-scope act, not a central statement of possession, and the same decision is taken for the parallel genitive in 22637. The in-scope kinship and request factoids of the passage are recorded.

decisions.finding: The content of the judgment, freedom from all imperial services, is not structured as a right via rf:concerns.
decisions.reason: 'auch weiterhin frei von allen Reichsdiensten sein sollen' describes an exemption. rv:RightTypes has no exemption or immunity concept, and RightShape requires a crm:P2_has_type from that scheme, so an E30_Right cannot be typed honestly. Forcing rv:LordshipRights or rv:Protection would change the historical meaning, which correct.md forbids. The wording survives in the evidence and 'auch weiterhin' in rf:qualifier.

decisions.finding: The judgment's evidence selector includes the particle 'bei' of Friedrich's accession; optionally split.
decisions.reason: The selector is a contiguous substring that carries type and roles of the judgment. The guideline asks for the shortest supporting passage but does not invalidate a selector for one extra particle, and the reviewer itself calls it cosmetic.

findings.description: 'Herzog Friedrichs von Schwaben' is identified with the shared ruler although candidate F000681 (Herzog von Schwaben, father of Barbarossa) also matches by name and title. findings.subject: urn:regesta:22654:uebergabe

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22654:schutzunterstellung
findings.description: The protected Ministerialien are rv:Beneficiary and the duke rv:Recipient; this is a reasonable reading (the duke receives the charge, the Ministerialien benefit), but the Latin 'in manus ... commisit' makes the Ministerialien the object handed over. rf:refersToAct is defined for confirmations or assurances referring to an earlier act; here it links a consequent act to its precondition, a stretch of the property. Typing the bishop's handover of persons as rv:Grant (transfer of a right, possession or institution) is also an approximation.
findings.proposal: Keep for this run; consider a sequence relation distinct from rf:refersToAct and a commendation or handover type for persons in the next contract.

The identification with the shared ruler is defensible; the file's comment already marks it as a reading, which the corrector keeps as an open identity.

decisions.finding: Konrad von Rietfeld (K000502) and Berengar von Albeck (B000529) appear only inside the rf:ground literal and are not referenced.

Adding them as rv:Participant to the handover factoid would assert participation in the bishop's transfer that the passage does not state. decisions.finding: Roles rv:Beneficiary for the Ministerialien and rv:Recipient for the duke, rf:refersToAct from the protection grant to the handover, and rv:Grant for a handover of persons are approximations.
decisions.reason: The duke receives the charge ('in manus Friderici ducis Suevię ... commisit') and the Ministerialien are those placed under protection, so Recipient and Beneficiary read the passage correctly. rf:refersToAct is defined for 'a later act such as a confirmation or assurance' that refers to an earlier act of the same regest; 'die genannten Bamberger Ministerialien, die ihm ... übergeben worden sind' is such a reference, and no date is asserted. rv:Grant is the nearest available type for the handover; a person-handover type is a gap for the next version, not a correction.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22657:transfer
findings.description: The transfer is typed with the generic rv:Grant although the summary states a counter-payment for it ('der dafür 10 Pfund erhält'). The contract has rv:Sale, defined as Übertragung gegen Entgelt, which the passage supports more precisely; the separate payment factoid shows the extractor read the consideration but did not type the main act accordingly. Whether a Tradition with Gegengabe is legally a sale is an expert question, so this is not an error.
findings.proposal: Retype to rv:Sale with Welf as rv:Seller and the monastery as rv:Buyer, keeping the payment factoid with rf:partOf; or keep rv:Grant and add rf:qualifier "dafür" so the consideration link stays visible.

findings.description: The parenthetical 'tunc dux Suevie postmodum imperator' states Friedrich's then and later office. Leaving it out is consistent with the guideline that office holding is recorded only where the statement needs it.

decisions.finding: The transfer is typed rv:Grant although the counter-payment would support rv:Sale.
decisions.reason: 'die Übergabe zweier Höfe an das Kloster durch Herzog Welf ..., der dafür 10 Pfund erhält' reports a Tradition with a counter-gift. Whether that is a sale is a legal judgment the regest does not make; rv:Grant is the broader concept that the passage certainly supports, and the separate rv:Payment factoid with rf:amount "10 Pfund" and rf:partOf already records the consideration. The reviewer itself declines to call it an error.

commentary.t: Hausmann führt in der Vorbemerkung zu diesem Diplom aus, daß es sich bei dem
avunculus

, mit dem Heinrich den Vertrag abgeschlossen hat, nicht um seinen Oheim, Herzog Friedrich II. von Schwaben, sondern um seinen älteren Vetter, Friedrich Barbarossa, handeln muß. Der Zeitpunkt dieses Vertragsabschlusses muß auf jeden Fall nach dem Aufbruch Konrads III. zum Kreuzzug (Ende Mai 1147) liegen, da der König sonst unmittelbar davon hätte erfahren müssen. Friedrich Barbarossa dürfte dann wohl erst etwas nach seinem Oheim zum Kreuzzug aufgebrochen sein. - Giesebrecht, Kaiserzeit IV, 326 und 487 sowie Bernhardi, Konrad III. 724 sehen im Vertragspartner des jungen Königs dagegen Gebhard von Sulzbach.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22682:peace
findings.description: The regest reports a peace mediated with stated terms, not merely a negotiation. rv:Negotiation is defined as not establishing a conclusion, so the factoid loses that a peace was reached, and the provisions then hang off an act that by definition has no outcome. rv:Enactment (a legal settlement made) would express the concluded peace within the contract; Friedrich as rv:Mediator fits either type.
findings.proposal: Type the peace as rv:Enactment with rf:qualifier "Frieden", keep Friedrich as rv:Mediator and Konrad and Welf as parties; report the missing peace-settlement type as model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22682:revenues
findings.description: The revenue clause is attached by rf:partOf to the peace yet typed as a performed rv:Grant, while the two other terms of the same peace are rv:Enactment. Either it is a term of the peace, then it is a provision (rv:Enactment), or it is a separate grant introduced by außerdem, then rf:partOf overreaches. The candidate's own comment marks the question as unresolved, but the triples assert one reading.
findings.proposal: Drop rf:partOf and keep a separate rv:Grant, or keep rf:partOf and type it rv:Enactment; do not combine both.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22682:no-fighting
findings.description: The reciprocity (dafür) between the return of the prisoners and Welf's undertaking is only implicit in the shared evidence span. The contract has no property linking two provisions as consideration.
findings.proposal: Optionally keep rf:qualifier "dafür"; report as model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22682:mertingen
findings.description: Mertingen is typed crm:E53_Place, while the regest has Welf receive the village together with the revenues, as an object of transfer. A crm:E18_Physical_Thing for the village would be closer.
findings.proposal: Type the village as crm:E18_Physical_Thing labelled "Dorf Mertingen".

decisions.finding: rv:Negotiation understates a mediated peace with stated terms.
decisions.reason: 'Friedrich vermittelt zwischen König Konrad (III.) und Herzog Welf (VI.) einen Frieden, nach dem Welf ...' reports a peace brokered with its terms, while rv:Negotiation is defined as not establishing a conclusion, so the provisions hang off an act that by definition has no outcome. rv:Enactment, a settlement made without its observance being established, expresses it within the contract and matches the treatment of the treaty in 22668 of this group. The regest does not say that Konrad and Welf negotiated, so the parties take rv:Participant.

decisions.finding: The revenue clause combines rf:partOf the peace with a performed rv:Grant.
decisions.reason: 'außerdem erhält Welf auch Reichseinkünfte mit dem Dorf Mertingen' stands in the same present-tense series as 'nach dem Welf die Gefangenen zurückerhält', which the candidate types as a provision; 'auch' links it to the terms of the peace. The guidelines make a provision an act of enactment that does not establish its performance, so the safe reading keeps rf:partOf and types the clause as a provision, without asserting a grantor or a completed transfer.

decisions.finding: Reciprocity 'dafür' between the two provisions is not represented.
decisions.reason: 'und dafür künftig nicht mehr gegen den König kämpfen wird': the contract has no property for consideration between provisions, and rf:qualifier is for wording that qualifies type or time, not for a relation between factoids. The word stays in the evidence.

decisions.finding: Mertingen typed crm:E53_Place instead of crm:E18_Physical_Thing.
decisions.reason: 'Reichseinkünfte mit dem Dorf Mertingen' can be read as the place the revenues attach to or as an estate; the regest does not decide it, and E53 with the label 'Dorf Mertingen' asserts nothing the passage does not carry.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:record:22687
findings.description: The regest's central political statement, that Konrad doubts his son's succession because of his youth and considers his nephew more suitable, has no factoid. As an assessment rather than an act or state it falls outside the act and state schemes, so this is mainly a model gap rather than an extraction error; but the ground wegen seiner Jugend could have been kept as rf:ground on a related factoid, and the file records the omission nowhere.
findings.proposal: Record as model gap (no type for a stated preference or designation of a successor); optionally add rf:ground "wegen seiner Jugend" to the entrustment factoid if the expert reads the doubt as its reason.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22687:entrustment-son
findings.description: Entrusting the young son is typed rv:Appointment (Beauftragung mit einer Aufgabe) with Konrad as rv:Grantor and Friedrich as rv:Recipient. This is a stretch the candidate flags itself; the son as rv:Participant is acceptable. Within the contract it is a reasonable provisional choice.
findings.proposal: Keep provisionally; record entrustment or guardianship as model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22687:advice-succession
findings.description: Advice is typed rv:Request with Konrad as rv:Petitioner. rv:Petitioner is defined as the one at whose request an act happens, so it fits the advising party only loosely; the purpose wegen seiner Nachfolge is not kept. rv:Addressee for Friedrich and the refusal to infer that negotiations took place are correct.
findings.proposal: Keep rv:Request provisionally; optionally add rf:qualifier "wegen seiner Nachfolge"; record advice as model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22687:grant-reichsinsignien
findings.description: The handover of the insignia by the dying king is typed rv:Grant. The regest does not say whether a right is transferred or the objects are handed over; the type is acceptable, but rf:qualifier "auf den Tod erkrankten" would keep the circumstance that frames the act.
findings.proposal: Optional: add the circumstance as rf:qualifier.

decisions.finding: Konrad's doubt about his son's succession and preference for his nephew have no factoid; optional rf:ground 'wegen seiner Jugend' on the entrustment.
decisions.reason: 'an dessen Nachfolge im Königreich er wegen seiner Jugend zweifelt, weshalb er seinen Neffen dazu für geeigneter ansieht' is an assessment, neither an act nor a state of the schemes. 'wegen seiner Jugend' is the reason for the doubt, not for the entrustment, so attaching it as rf:ground of the entrustment would misattribute it. The extractor records the gap in its batch report.

decisions.finding: Optional rf:qualifier 'wegen seiner Nachfolge' on the advice.
decisions.reason: 'wegen seiner Nachfolge' states the subject of the advised negotiations, not a qualification of type or time, and it stays in the evidence. The contract does not require it as a literal.

decisions.finding: Optional rf:qualifier 'auf den Tod erkrankten' on the handover of the insignia.
decisions.reason: 'von seinem auf den Tod erkrankten Oheim' describes Konrad's condition, not the type or time of the act, and is in the evidence already.

transmission.t: Ottonis Gesta Frid. l. I cap. 70, ed. Waitz-Simson, MG. SS rer. Germ. in us. schol. 98; Chron. reg. Col., ed. Waitz, MG. SS rer. Germ. in us. schol. 88. Für den Sohn Konrads III., Friedrich, war die Nachfolge im Herzogtum Schwaben vorgesehen, vgl. Burchard von Ursberg, ed. Holder-Egger-Simson, MG. SS rer. Germ. in us. schol. 20, Hugonis Chron. cont. Weingart., MG. SS XXI, 474. Den Vorwurf, daß Friedrich seinen Vetter um sein Erbe betrogen habe, machen Chron. s. Clementis Mettense, MG. SS XXIV, 501, Chron. princ. Sax. ampl., MG. SS XXX/1, 29 f. (beide mit falschem Namen für den Sohn Konrads III.); vgl. dazu auch Gesta epp. Halberstad., MG. SS XXIII, 107 und Kaiserchronik Anhang I, V. 23 ff. MG. Dt. Chroniken I, 397. Zur Frage der Designation Friedrichs durch seinen Oheim vgl. auch die Selbstaussage Barbarossas in seinem Brief an den oströmischen Kaiser Manuel (Reg. 197), ed. Jaffé, Mon. Corb. 548 n
imperator Conradus, moriens, cum nos declarasset imperii sui successores

. Ioannes Cinnamus, Epitome l. II cap. 20, ed. Meineke, CSHB 13 (1836) 89 führt die Nachfolge Friedrichs auf eine eidliche Übereinkunft zwischen seinem Vater und Konrad zurück, nach der das Reich nach dem Tod Konrads eben an ihn fallen müsse.

regests.lead: Königswahl : Friedrich wird gemäß dem Reichsrecht (Ottonis Gesta Frid. l II cap. 1: nam id iuris Romani imperii apex, videlicet non per sanguinis propaginem descendere, sed per principum electionem reges creare, sibi tamquam ex singulari vendicat prerogativa) in Anwesenheit einer großen Zahl von Fürsten, auch aus Italien, unter Zustimmung aller zum König gewählt.
regests.text: Königswahl : Friedrich wird gemäß dem Reichsrecht (Ottonis Gesta Frid. l II cap. 1: nam id iuris Romani imperii apex, videlicet non per sanguinis propaginem descendere, sed per principum electionem reges creare, sibi tamquam ex singulari vendicat prerogativa) in Anwesenheit einer großen Zahl von Fürsten, auch aus Italien, unter Zustimmung aller zum König gewählt. Die Erzbischöfe Arnold II. von Köln und Hillin von Trier treten besonders für ihn ein. Als Grund für diese Wahl nennt Otto von Freising die Verwandtschaft Friedrichs mit Staufern und Welfen, die eben dazu geführt habe, daß die Fürsten ihn nicht regis Conradi zelo, sondern unter Bedachtnahme auf das Gemeinwohl dem kleinen Sohn des verstorbenen Königs, Friedrich, vorgezogen haben. Nach durchgeführter Wahl läßt sich Friedrich von allen anwesenden Fürsten Treueid und Mannschaft leisten.

gaps.text: No act type for a royal election; recorded as rv:Appointment with rf:qualifier 'zum König gewählt'.
No act type for the oath of fealty and homage ('Treueid und Mannschaft leisten') after the election; the passage is left out rather than read as an rv:FeudalRelationship state.
rf:ground cannot record that the reason for the election is attributed to Otto von Freising; the attribution to a narrative author is lost.
No role for supporters of a candidate; the archbishops who 'treten besonders für ihn ein' carry rv:Participant.
The princes' preference of Friedrich over the late king's son ('vorgezogen haben', 'unter Bedachtnahme auf das Gemeinwohl') has no place beyond the election factoid and is not recorded separately.
No act type for an oath of fealty or homage; only the resulting state rv:FeudalRelationship can be expressed.
No property for attributing a ground or statement to a narrative source named inside the regest (here Otto of Freising).
No role for supporters of a candidate in an election (Arnold and Hillin 'treten besonders für ihn ein') or for a passed-over rival.

corrections.text: urn:regesta:22691:election: rf:ground replaced by the exact literal "Als Grund für diese Wahl nennt Otto von Freising die Verwandtschaft Friedrichs mit Staufern und Welfen"; producer set to correction-g4.
urn:regesta:22691:kinship-staufer-welfen and urn:regesta:22691:parenthood-king-son unchanged.

findings.description: The final sentence reports that all princes present swore fealty and did homage to Friedrich after the election. This establishes a lord-vassal relation and is in scope, but no factoid represents it.
findings.proposal: Add a StateFactoid rv:FeudalRelationship (Friedrich rv:Lord, local group 'allen anwesenden Fürsten' rv:Vassal) with rf:qualifier "Treueid und Mannschaft" and "Nach durchgeführter Wahl", or report it as a model gap if an oath act type is wanted.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22691:election
findings.description: The regest explicitly attributes the reason for the election to Otto of Freising. As rf:ground of the election the reason appears as the regest's own, and the attribution is lost. The kinship StateFactoid rests on the same attributed passage.
findings.proposal: Extend the rf:ground literal to start with "Als Grund für diese Wahl nennt Otto von Freising" or add rf:qualifier "nennt Otto von Freising" on both the election and the kinship factoid.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22691:election
findings.description: The preference of Friedrich over the young son of the deceased king, with the stated consideration of the common good, is not captured; only the parenthood is extracted from that clause.
findings.proposal: Add rf:ground "unter Bedachtnahme auf das Gemeinwohl" to the election and reference the son as a further participant, or record a model gap for a rival candidate role.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22691:parenthood-king-son
findings.description: The child's nameInSource is the whole descriptive phrase rather than the naming wording.
findings.proposal: Use rf:nameInSource "Friedrich" (or "dem kleinen Sohn") for the Child reference.

decisions.finding: The closing oath of fealty and homage is not extracted; proposed as rv:FeudalRelationship.
decisions.reason: 'läßt sich Friedrich von allen anwesenden Fürsten Treueid und Mannschaft leisten' states an oath act, but the contract has no act type for fealty or homage, and rv:FeudalRelationship is defined as holding something as a fief ('trägt etwas von einem anderen zu Lehen'), which the passage does not state. Building that state would overstate the passage.

decisions.finding: The rf:ground loses the regest's attribution of the reason to Otto von Freising.
decisions.reason: The regest gives the reason only as Otto's: 'Als Grund für diese Wahl nennt Otto von Freising die Verwandtschaft Friedrichs mit Staufern und Welfen'. The current ground 'die Verwandtschaft Friedrichs mit Staufern und Welfen' presents it as the regest's own. A longer exact literal keeps the attribution within the contract. The kinship state factoid stays unchanged; attributing a state to a narrative author has no property and remains a model gap.

decisions.finding: The preference over the late king's son 'unter Bedachtnahme auf das Gemeinwohl' is not captured.
decisions.reason: The clause belongs to Otto's account of the reason ('die eben dazu geführt habe, daß die Fürsten ihn ... dem kleinen Sohn des verstorbenen Königs, Friedrich, vorgezogen haben'). The vocabulary has no role for a passed-over rival, and adding the son as Participant would misstate his part; the parenthood already extracted is the in-scope content of the clause.

decisions.finding: The child's rf:nameInSource is the whole descriptive phrase rather than 'Friedrich'.
decisions.reason: The guidelines ask for the exact wording naming the actor in the passage; 'dem kleinen Sohn des verstorbenen Königs, Friedrich' is that wording and an exact substring, and it keeps the local son apart from the ruler, who is also named 'Friedrich'.

commentary.t: Zur Wahl vgl. Simonsfeld, Jahrbücher 28 ff. und 667 ff., zur Datierung (bei Otto von Freising irrig zu März 5) a. a. O. 28 f. Anm. 48, zu den Teilnehmern a. a. O. 31 f. Neuerdings befaßt sich Engels, Beiträge zur Geschichte der Staufer, DA 27 (1971) 399 ff. eingehend mit der Wahl Friedrichs I. und deutet die in späteren Quellen, besonders bei Gislebert von Mons, vorhandenen Hinweise auf ein Intrigenspiel des Staufers in der Weise, daß hier die Zusagen Barbarossas für eine Wahlhilfe in verzerrter Form ihren Niederschlag gefunden hätten; vgl. dazu auch Unverhau, Approbatio-Reprobatio (Hist. Studien 424, 1973) 150 ff. - Zur Weihe Friedrichs vgl. Reinhardt, Stellung der Geistlichkeit bei den Königswahlen (Untersuch. u. Mat. zur Landesgesch. 4, 1975) 215 ff.

regests.lead: Königskrönung : Friedrich wird am Sonntag Letare Jerusalem (März 9) in der Marienkirche von Erzbischof Arnold von Köln unter Mitwirkung anderer Bischöfe nach Ablegung des herkömmlichen Krönungseides unter Akklamation des Volkes gesalbt, gekrönt und auf den Thron Karls des Großen gesetzt.
regests.text: Königskrönung : Friedrich wird am Sonntag Letare Jerusalem (März 9) in der Marienkirche von Erzbischof Arnold von Köln unter Mitwirkung anderer Bischöfe nach Ablegung des herkömmlichen Krönungseides unter Akklamation des Volkes gesalbt, gekrönt und auf den Thron Karls des Großen gesetzt. Trotz der Feierlichkeit des Tages vergibt er einem seiner Ministerialen, dem er wegen seiner Vergehen die Gunst entzogen hat und der sich ihm nun zu Füßen wirft, nicht und stellt damit seine unbedingte Liebe zur Gerechtigkeit unter Beweis. Am selben Tag wird von denselben Bischöfen auch der neue Bischof von Münster, der ebenfalls Friedrich heißt, geweiht, was man als gutes Vorzeichen ansieht. Am nächsten Tag verhandelt Friedrich in den Gemächern der Pfalz mit den Fürsten: Der Antritt des von seinem Vorgänger angeordneten Italienzuges zur Kaiserkrönung, zu dem die geistlichen Fürsten, vor allem der Kölner Erzbischof, raten, wird wegen der Einwände der Laienfürsten, die auf die gespannte innere Lage des Reiches und auf die Würde des Königs (Reg. 73: decere etiam, ut vocatus á vobis potius quam sponte sua veniret) hinweisen, vorläufig aufgeschoben. Die Entsendung einer Legation, bestehend aus dem Elekten Hillin von Trier, Bischof Eberhard von Bamberg und Abt Adam von Ebrach (vgl. Reg. 72), an Papst Eugen (III.), die Stadt Rom und ganz Italien zur Anzeige der Wahl des neuen Königs wird beschlossen.

findings.description: The decision to send a legation of Hillin, Eberhard and Adam to Pope Eugen, Rome and Italy to announce the election is a central in-scope act that rv:Mission with rv:Envoy and rv:Addressee expresses directly; all actors have candidates in this packet. It is missing.
findings.proposal: Add an ActFactoid rv:Mission with Hillin (RI004-002-H001017), Eberhard (RI004-002-E000011), Adam (RI004-002-A000294) as rv:Envoy, Eugen (RI004-002-E000589) and Rome as rv:Addressee, rf:qualifier "wird beschlossen" so the decision is not read as the departure.

findings.description: The negotiation of Friedrich with the princes on the next day and its outcome, the provisional postponement of the Italian expedition for the imperial coronation on the objections of the lay princes, are not extracted. The predecessor's order of the expedition is an earlier act mentioned in the same clause.
findings.proposal: Add an rv:Negotiation factoid (Friedrich and local group 'den Fürsten' as rv:Negotiator) and an rv:Enactment for the postponement with rf:qualifier "vorläufig aufgeschoben" and rf:ground "wegen der Einwände der Laienfürsten"; optionally the advice of the spiritual princes as rv:Request.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22693:coronation
findings.description: The coronation oath sworn before the anointing is an act of Friedrich (a promise) that is only folded into the evidence of the coronation factoid.
findings.proposal: Add an rv:Assurance factoid with Friedrich as Grantor and rf:qualifier "herkömmlichen Krönungseides", linked by rf:partOf to the coronation.

findings.description: The refusal to pardon a ministerial whom Friedrich had deprived of his favour because of his offences states a lordship relation and an earlier withdrawal of favour; the contract has no fitting act type.
findings.proposal: Record as a model gap, or extract the withdrawal of favour as rv:Revocation with rf:ground "wegen seiner Vergehen".

decisions.finding: The decided legation of Hillin, Eberhard and Adam to Pope Eugen, Rome and Italy is missing.
decisions.reason: 'Die Entsendung einer Legation, bestehend aus dem Elekten Hillin von Trier, Bischof Eberhard von Bamberg und Abt Adam von Ebrach (vgl. Reg. 72), an Papst Eugen (III.), die Stadt Rom und ganz Italien zur Anzeige der Wahl des neuen Königs wird beschlossen.' is central, and the guidelines treat missions and their addressees explicitly. The passage states a decision, not the departure, so the rv:Mission must carry 'wird beschlossen' as qualifier. All four persons have candidates of this packet matching by name and title (H001017, E000011, A000294, E000589). Rome and Italy are places in the register and are not turned into community actors.

decisions.finding: Negotiation with the princes and the postponement of the Italian expedition are not extracted.
decisions.reason: 'Der Antritt des von seinem Vorgänger angeordneten Italienzuges zur Kaiserkrönung ... wird ... vorläufig aufgeschoben' concerns a military expedition, which the guidelines exclude without a kinship, economic or legal relation, and the vocabulary has no type for a postponement decision; rv:Enactment is a legal provision the charter makes.

decisions.finding: The coronation oath should be a separate rv:Assurance partOf the coronation.
decisions.reason: 'nach Ablegung des herkömmlichen Krönungseides' mentions the oath only as a circumstance of the coronation; it states neither content nor addressee, so a separate Assurance would carry nothing beyond the wording already inside the coronation's evidence.

decisions.finding: Refusal to pardon a ministerial after withdrawal of favour is not extracted.
decisions.reason: 'vergibt er einem seiner Ministerialen, dem er wegen seiner Vergehen die Gunst entzogen hat ... nicht' has no act type for withdrawal of favour or refused pardon; rv:Revocation means annulling an earlier grant or provision and would change the historical meaning.

commentary.t: Vgl. Simonsfeld, Jahrbücher 42 ff. - Friedrich hat die Diener der Marienkirche in Aachen der öffentlichen Besteuerung durch Schultheiß, Ministerialen und Bürger von Aachen entzogen und unter die bürgerliche Gerichtsbarkeit der Kirche gestellt; dies geht aus der Urkunde König Ottos IV., ed. Meuthen, Aachener Urkunden 243 n
o
52, B.-Ficker Reg.
hervor (
Predecessoris itaque nostri Friderici Rom(anorum) imperatoris exemplo

...). Obwohl also Friedrich hier als Kaiser erwähnt ist, haben wir die Nachricht zum ersten bezeugten Aufenthalt in Aachen gesetzt, da von keiner urkundlichen Verfügung des Staufers, sondern von einer offenbar gewohnheitsrechtlichen Regelung gesprochen wird, deren Anfänge wohl kaum erst nach der Kaiserkrönung liegen.

regests.lead: Friedrich bestätigt dem Kloster S. Remi zu Reims (cenobii sancti Remigii confessoris et Francorum apostoli, quod est in regno Francorum Remis) auf Bitten von dessen Abt Hugo, der am zweiten Tag nach seiner Krönung in der Aachener Pfalz vor ihm erschienen ist, alle in seinem Reich gelegenen Besitzungen, besonders das zu Meerssen gehörige Gut Leuth (Littam, que ad Marsnam pertinet), das Herzog Gottfried von Löwen erst nach Ermahnung durch König Konrad (III.) zurückgestellt hat, trifft eingehende Bestimmungen über die Vogtei, verbietet zusätzlich die Einsetzung von Untervögten und verordnet, daß die Meerssener Pfründen nach dem Tod ihrer Inhaber ohne Einspruch zur weiteren Verfügung der Mönche stehen sollen.

regests.text: Friedrich schenkt zu seinem und seines in der Domkirche zu Bamberg beigesetzten Oheims und Vorgängers, König Konrad III., ewigem Angedenken auf Bitten Bischof Eberhards II. von Bamberg diesem, seinen Nachfolgern und seiner Kirche zur Hebung des religiösen Lebens die in weltlicher und geistlicher Hinsicht in trostlosem Zustand befindliche Reichsabtei Niederaltaich (abbatiam nostram Altaha). Der Bischof oder sein kanonisch gewählter Nachfolger hat das Recht der Investitur des Abtes, die Vogtei mit den Ministerialen und Hörigen beiderlei Geschlechts geht an die Bamberger Kirche über, wobei dem Abt und den Mönchen ihre Einkünfte (stipendia) aber unvermindert erhalten bleiben sollen; die jährlichen Abgaben an den Fiskus (Ea vero, quę fisco exrinde annuatim solvebantur) fallen künftig an den Bischof, der aber die bisherigen Verpflichtungen des Klosters gegenüber dem Reich übernimmt und für die Bedürfnisse der Abtei sorgt (quatenus episcopus vice abbatis plenius et devotius curię regali deservire et necessitatibus predicti monasterii commodius et uberius providere valeat). Z.: Erzbischof Arnold von Köln, die Bischöfe Hermann von Konstanz, Ortlieb von Basel, Abt Wibald (Gwinebaldvs) von Corvey, Markgraf Albrecht von Sachsen, Markward von Grumbach. - Data per manum Arnoldi canc. vice archicanc. Heinrici Moguntini archiep. ; nach Bamberger Diktat geschrieben vom Bamberger Kleriker Gotebold; SI. 1. Quia placuit altissimo .

regests.lead: Friedrich legt auf Grund eines unter Konrad III. erneuerten Urteilsspruches des Hofgerichts die Rechte der Vögte des Domkapitels zu Lüttich (ius advocatorum et terminum iuris eorum) fest, bestimmt, daß die Vogtei nur der mit dem Königsbann Belehnte (nisi quem constaret bannum regie auctoritatis habere) ausüben dürfe, verbietet das Eintreiben von Abgaben in einer Höhe, die dem Zeugnis und den Urkunden der Schöffen und Dorfbewohner (quod auctoritas privilegiorum et testimonium scabinorum et villarum fidelium perhiberet veraci attestatione) widerspricht und bestätigt die Privilegien der Stadt und des Stiftes, die durch seinen Oheim erneuert worden sind.
regests.text: Friedrich legt auf Grund eines unter Konrad III. erneuerten Urteilsspruches des Hofgerichts die Rechte der Vögte des Domkapitels zu Lüttich (ius advocatorum et terminum iuris eorum) fest, bestimmt, daß die Vogtei nur der mit dem Königsbann Belehnte (nisi quem constaret bannum regie auctoritatis habere) ausüben dürfe, verbietet das Eintreiben von Abgaben in einer Höhe, die dem Zeugnis und den Urkunden der Schöffen und Dorfbewohner (quod auctoritas privilegiorum et testimonium scabinorum et villarum fidelium perhiberet veraci attestatione) widerspricht und bestätigt die Privilegien der Stadt und des Stiftes, die durch seinen Oheim erneuert worden sind. Z.: die Erzbischöfe Arnold von Köln, Hillin von Trier (Triuirensis), die Bischöfe Heinrich von Lüttich, Eberhard von Bamberg, Otto von Freising, Hermann von Konstanz, Ortlieb von Basel, Friedrich von Münster, Abt Wibald von Stablo, Herzog Heinrich von Sachsen, Welf von Ravensburg (Rauenesber), Markgraf Albrecht und Herzog Matthäus von Lothringen. - Arnoldus canc. vice Henrici Moguntini archiep. et archicanc. ; verfaßt und wahrscheinlich auch mundiert von Heribert. Sicut divina preordinante .

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22697:earlier-judgment
findings.description: The passage speaks of a court judgment renewed under Konrad III. The candidate types the renewed judgment as one rv:Judgment with Konrad as Participant, collapsing the original judgment and its renewal; the time of the original judgment is not under Konrad.
findings.proposal: Split into an rv:Judgment by 'des Hofgerichts' without a ruler reference and an rv:Confirmation (renewal) with Konrad III and rf:qualifier "erneuerten", joined by rf:refersToAct.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:actor:22697:local:stift
findings.description: 'der Stadt' is identified with the register entry Lüttich Stadt while 'des Stiftes' is left local, although the packet carries the Domkapitel Lüttich entry already used for 'Domkapitels zu Lüttich'. Either both are inferred from context or neither.
findings.proposal: Treat both consistently: identify 'des Stiftes' with RI004-002-L000934:community or keep 'der Stadt' local too.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22697:enactment-voegte
findings.description: The Domkapitel is a Participant; it is the body whose advocates are regulated and would fit rv:Beneficiary. The 'Oheim' is correctly kept local rather than identified with Konrad III through the register label.
findings.proposal: Optionally use rv:Beneficiary for the Domkapitel.

decisions.finding: The original judgment and its renewal under Konrad III are collapsed into one rv:Judgment.
decisions.reason: The passage names one judgment of the court, 'eines unter Konrad III. erneuerten Urteilsspruches des Hofgerichts', and that renewed judgment is what Friedrich relies on. It says nothing of the original judgment beyond 'erneuerten', which the qualifier keeps; splitting would assign the original to the court and the renewal to Konrad, a reading the wording does not settle.

decisions.finding: 'der Stadt' is identified with a register entry while 'des Stiftes' is kept local; treat both alike.
decisions.reason: The packet carries a candidate for the city of Liège (L000932, 'Stadt') matching 'der Stadt' in a regest about Liège. 'des Stiftes' may mean the Hochstift or the Domkapitel (L000934), so a local actor is the cautious reading. The asymmetry follows the evidence.

decisions.finding: The Domkapitel could be rv:Beneficiary instead of rv:Participant.
decisions.reason: 'die Rechte der Vögte des Domkapitels zu Lüttich ... fest' does not say that the act is in favour of the chapter; rv:Participant does not overstate.

commentary.t: Zur Bezeichnung Friedrichs als erster seines Namens vgl. die Vorbemerkung zum vorliegenden D. - Bei der Erneuerung der Privilegien durch Konrad III., die Friedrich hier bestätigt, handelt es sich um ein Deperditum.

gaps.text: Commission of seal dies by Wibald 'im Auftrag des Königs' is a chancery-administrative act without kinship, economic or legal content; abstained

findings.description: The king commissions Wibald with having the seal dies made. This is a commission with named parties, not a chancery note on the charter, and the contract's rv:Appointment covers commissioning with a task. The making of the dies itself is performance and need not be a factoid.
findings.proposal: Add an ActFactoid rv:Appointment with the shared ruler (nameInSource "des Königs") as Grantor and Wibald (RI004-002-W000420) as Recipient, rf:qualifier "im Auftrag".

decisions.finding: The abstention is questionable; the king's commission to Wibald should be an rv:Appointment.
decisions.reason: 'Wibald läßt im Auftrag des Königs die zur Besiegelung der Diplome nötigen Siegelstempel ... herstellen' reports chancery production of seal dies; the commission is only presupposed by 'im Auftrag', the passage states no kinship, economic or legal relation, and the guidelines exclude seal matters. The abstention is defensible and a correction must not widen the scope.

regests.lead: Friedrich unterrichtet Papst Eugen (III.) nach der Sitte seiner Vorgänger durch seine Legaten Bischof E(berhard) von Bamberg, Elekt H(illin) von Trier und Abt A(dam) von Ebrach und dieses Schreiben über seine Fortschritte und den Zustand von Kirche und Reich.
regests.text: Friedrich unterrichtet Papst Eugen (III.) nach der Sitte seiner Vorgänger durch seine Legaten Bischof E(berhard) von Bamberg, Elekt H(illin) von Trier und Abt A(dam) von Ebrach und dieses Schreiben über seine Fortschritte und den Zustand von Kirche und Reich. Er zeigt ihm seine am 17. Tag (= 1152 März 4) nach dem Ableben König K(onrads III.) zu Frankfurt in Eintracht erfolgte Wahl durch die Fürsten (universi principes regni tamquam divino spiritu suscitati XVIIa die post depositionem eius in oppidum Frankeneuurt tam per se ipsos quam per responsales honoratos convenerunt et absque ullius morę interiecto spacio eadem die cum ingenti divinitus data concordia ipsi principes et cęteri proceres cum totius populi favore et alacritate nos in regni fastigium elegerunt.) und die am fünften Tag danach (März 9) durch Erzbischof A(rnold) von Köln und andere Bischöfe unter Akklamation des Volkes zu Aachen vorgenommene Königssalbung sowie die Thronsetzung [Quinta postmodum die, id est transacta proxime mediante quadragesima, pari et eodem consensu cum benivola populi acclamatione in oppido Aquisgrani nos per sacratissimas devoti filii vestri A(rnoldi) Coloniensis metropolitani et venerabilium episcoporum manus oleo sanctificationis regaliter unxerunt et in solio regni cum benedictione sollempni collocaverunt.] an. Er verspricht ihm, die römische Kirche nach seinem Krönungseid (iuxta professionis nostrę formulam, quam ab orthodoxis presulibus in ipso regni throno et unctione sacra accepimus) zu schützen, den Witwen, Waisen und dem ihm anvertrauten Volk den Frieden zu bringen und zu bewahren, die katholische Kirche in ihren Privilegien zu schützen, den früheren Glanz des Reiches unter Beachtung des Grundsatzes von den zwei Gewalten wiederherzustellen (Cum enim duo sint, quibus principaliter hic mundus regitur, videlicet auctoritas sacra pontificum et regalis potestas, ... parati sumus, ut propitia divinitate temporibus nostri principatus verbum dei expedite currere non prohibeatur et paternas regulas ac decreta sanctissimis diffinita conciliis nullus audeat absque penę gravioris vindicta violare, quatinus per studii nostri instantiam catholica ecclesia suę dignitatis privilegiis decoretur et Romani imperii celsitudo in pristinum suę excellentię robur deo adiuvante reformetur.) und die von seinem Vorgänger dem Papst gegenüber gemachten Zusagen zu erfüllen sowie des Papstes Feinde auch als die seinigen zu betrachten. Er empfiehlt ihm seine Legaten und bittet um baldige Rücksendung des Abtes von Ebrach. - Unter Heranziehung des Wortlauts der Krönungseide der römischen Könige verfaßt von Wibald. Patrem patrię decet .

gaps.text: No sender role for a communication; the sender is recorded as rv:Participant.

Political promise to restore the Reich under the two-powers principle and the request to send back the abbot of Ebrach judged out of scope and not recorded.

findings.description: The promise to restore the former splendour of the empire under the two-powers principle is one of the listed promises; the candidate splits every other promise of the sentence into its own Assurance but drops this one, which the contract expresses in the same way.
findings.proposal: Add an rv:Assurance with Friedrich as Grantor, Eugen as Addressee, rf:qualifier "unter Beachtung des Grundsatzes von den zwei Gewalten", rf:partOf the communication.

findings.description: The anointing and enthronement by Archbishop Arnold of Cologne and other bishops at Aachen, notified in the letter, is not extracted, although the election in the same sentence is. Arnold has a candidate in the packet.
findings.proposal: Add an rv:Appointment with Friedrich as Recipient, Arnold (RI004-002-A001202) as Grantor, 'andere Bischöfe' and 'des Volkes' as Participant, rf:qualifier "Königssalbung sowie die Thronsetzung".

findings.description: The recommendation of the legates and the request for the early return of the abbot of Ebrach are a request to the pope that rv:Request expresses.
findings.proposal: Add an rv:Request with Friedrich as requester, Eugen as rv:Addressee and Adam (RI004-002-A000294, 'des Abtes von Ebrach') as Participant, rf:qualifier "baldige", rf:partOf the communication.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:actor:22699:local:vorgaenger
findings.description: 'seinem Vorgänger' denotes an individual, King Konrad III named earlier in the same regest, rather than an office-determined actor; rf:FunctionalActor is meant for 'der jeweilige' kinds. Keeping it local is cautious but the type is off.
findings.proposal: Type the local actor crm:E21_Person, or identify it with RI004-002-K000316 if the reviewer accepts the in-regest co-reference.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22699:communication
findings.description: The sender of the letter carries rv:Participant because the vocabulary has no sender role; the pope is rv:Beneficiary in the enemies promise but rv:Addressee in the others.
findings.proposal: Use rv:Addressee for Eugen consistently and keep Participant for the sender until the vocabulary has a sender role.

decisions.finding: The promise to restore the former splendour of the empire is omitted while all sibling promises are extracted.
decisions.reason: 'den früheren Glanz des Reiches unter Beachtung des Grundsatzes von den zwei Gewalten wiederherzustellen' is one of the promises governed by 'Er verspricht ihm'; the other promises are rv:Assurance factoids partOf the communication, so omitting this one is inconsistent and the contract expresses it the same way.

decisions.finding: The notified anointing and enthronement by Archbishop Arnold and other bishops is not extracted.
decisions.reason: The same sentence's election is extracted as rv:Appointment, and the coronation in 22693 is typed rv:Appointment, so omitting 'die am fünften Tag danach (März 9) durch Erzbischof A(rnold) von Köln und andere Bischöfe unter Akklamation des Volkes zu Aachen vorgenommene Königssalbung sowie die Thronsetzung' leaves the record inconsistent. Arnold matches candidate A001202 by name and see.

decisions.finding: The request for the early return of the abbot of Ebrach (with the recommendation of the legates) is missing.
decisions.reason: 'Er empfiehlt ihm seine Legaten und bittet um baldige Rücksendung des Abtes von Ebrach.' is a request that rv:Request expresses. The vocabulary has no requester role and rv:Petitioner presupposes a performed act, so the sender stays rv:Participant as in the communication; the recommendation has no act type and stays a gap. 'des Abtes von Ebrach' matches candidate A000294 ('Abt von Ebrach') by title, and the same summary names him 'Abt A(dam) von Ebrach'.

decisions.finding: 'seinem Vorgänger' is an individual and should not be an rf:FunctionalActor, or should be Konrad III.
decisions.reason: rf:FunctionalActor is defined for an actor the regest determines by office or function rather than by name; 'seinem Vorgänger' is exactly such a determination. Identifying it with K000316 would rest on co-reference inference, which the guidelines do not license.

decisions.finding: Sender as rv:Participant and the pope as rv:Beneficiary in the enemies promise; use rv:Addressee consistently.
decisions.reason: The vocabulary has no sender role, so rv:Participant is the contract's fallback. In 'des Papstes Feinde auch als die seinigen zu betrachten' the pope is the one in whose favour the promise is made, which rv:Beneficiary states correctly.

regests.lead: (Wibald ) schreibt an Papst Eugen (III.) über die Ereignisse nach seiner Rückkehr von der letzten Gesandtschaftsreise nach Rom, nämlich die nach dem Tode König Konrads (III.) erfolgte Wahl Herzog Friedrichs von Schwaben zu dessen Nachfolger, wobei er kurz über dessen Alter und Eigenschaften spricht (nondum ut credimus annorum triginta, fuit antehac ingenio acer, consilio promptus, bello felix, rerum arduarum et gloriae appetens, iniuriae omnio impatiens, affabilis ac liberalis, et splendide disertus iuxta gentile idioma linguae suae), sowie über die Aachener Beratungen am Tag nach der Krönung (März 10), die eine Ablehnung der sofortigen Beschwörung eines Italienzuges durch die Laienfürsten brachten, und rät ihm, Friedrich zum König und Verteidiger der Kirche zu erklären (sit vobiscum magni consilii angelus, ut declaretis eum in regem ac defensorem Romane aecclesiae ).

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22700:election
findings.description: The election is to the succession of King Konrad III, who has a candidate in this packet. The qualifier 'zu dessen Nachfolger' keeps a pronoun whose referent is not represented, so the succession relation is lost.
findings.proposal: Add a reference to RI004-002-K000316 (nameInSource "König Konrads (III.)") as rv:Participant and keep rf:qualifier "nach dem Tode" and "zu dessen Nachfolger".

findings.description: The letter reports the Aachen deliberations, in which the lay princes rejected the immediate swearing of an Italian expedition. This is a reported collective decision not represented.
findings.proposal: Add an rv:Negotiation factoid with local group 'die Laienfürsten' as rv:Negotiator and rf:qualifier "Ablehnung der sofortigen Beschwörung eines Italienzuges", or report it as a model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22700:advice-declare-king
findings.description: Advice is typed rv:Request; the vocabulary has no advice type, and the qualifier 'rät' preserves the wording. Wibald as author is rv:Participant for lack of a sender role.
findings.proposal: None required.

decisions.finding: The election to the succession of Konrad III loses its reference to Konrad.
decisions.reason: 'die nach dem Tode König Konrads (III.) erfolgte Wahl Herzog Friedrichs von Schwaben zu dessen Nachfolger' names Konrad (candidate K000316), but he takes no part in the election; rv:Participant would misstate him, and the vocabulary has no predecessor role. The safe fix keeps the temporal wording that names him.

decisions.finding: The Aachen deliberations rejecting an immediate oath for an Italian expedition are not extracted.
decisions.reason: 'die eine Ablehnung der sofortigen Beschwörung eines Italienzuges durch die Laienfürsten brachten' concerns a military expedition reported in a letter and states no kinship, economic or legal relation; it is out of scope.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22701:fine
findings.description: König Konrad (III.) is named in the ground of the fine and has a register candidate in this packet (RI004-002-K000316), but he appears only inside the rf:ground literal and not as a reference. findings.proposal: Optionally add a reference to urn:regesta:actor:RI004-002-K000316 with rf:nameInSource "König Konrad (III.)"; otherwise record the missing role as a model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22701:fine
findings.description: The citizens carry rv:Obligor, a role defined for an existing duty. For a fine imposed as a penalty this is defensible but not exact; the vocabulary has no role for the party sanctioned by an act.
findings.proposal: Keep rv:Obligor and record the missing penalty role as a model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22701:confirmation-bishop
findings.description: The second selector "Friedrich belegt" is used to anchor the grantor of the confirmation. It is a substring of the regest and Friedrich is the grammatical subject of both clauses, so the role is supported, but the selector quotes the verb of the other act.
findings.proposal: Acceptable as is; a reader should know that the selector anchors only the subject.

decisions.finding: König Konrad (III.) appears only inside the rf:ground literal and not as a reference.
decisions.reason: In 'wegen ihrer Aufsässigkeit (contumacia) gegen König Konrad (III.)' Konrad is the target of the offence, not a party to the fine; the vocabulary has no role for it, and rv:Participant would misstate him. The wording stays in rf:ground.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22705:restitution
findings.description: The restitution returns the very estate that the earlier donation conveyed (den ihr ... geschenkten Hof), and it rests on the earlier judgment that had denied the estate to Heinrich von Molsberg. Neither the donation nor the judgment is linked to the restitution, so the dependency the regest states is lost; the donation and judgment float as unconnected acts.
findings.proposal: Add rf:refersToAct from urn:regesta:22705:restitution to urn:regesta:22705:donation (and, if the reading is accepted, to urn:regesta:22705:judgment-hofgericht).

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22705:possession-kirche-koeln
findings.description: "dessen Kirche dieses Gut gehört" states ownership by the Cologne church while the abbey is the one receiving the estate. rv:Possession is the closest state type, but it flattens the distinction between ownership and holding that the regest implies; Arnold, through whom the church is introduced (dessen), is not referenced.
findings.proposal: Keep rv:Possession, add the qualifier "gehört" in exact wording, and record ownership versus possession as a model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22705:confirmation-arnold
findings.description: "kraft seiner und der päpstlichen Gewalt" names the authority on which the confirmation rests. It is stored as rf:qualifier; rf:ground would also fit. The papal authority is not linked to any actor, which is correct since the German text names no pope.
findings.proposal: Acceptable as rf:qualifier; consider rf:ground for consistency with other basis-of-authority phrases.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22705:donation
findings.description: Pfalzgraf Heinrich is called the founder of the abbey (ihrem Gründer). The contract has no act or state type for foundation, so it cannot be expressed beyond the donation.
findings.proposal: Record as model gap; optionally add rf:qualifier "ihrem Gründer" to the donation.

decisions.finding: The restitution is not linked to the donation of the same estate.
decisions.reason: 'den ihr von ihrem Gründer, Pfalzgraf Heinrich, geschenkten Hof Bendorf (Bedendorf) zurück' states that the restitution returns what the earlier donation gave; rf:refersToAct is defined for a later act referring to an earlier act of the same regest. The passage does not say the restitution rests on the court judgment, so that link is not added.

decisions.finding: rv:Possession flattens 'gehört' (ownership); keep the exact word.
decisions.reason: 'dessen Kirche dieses Gut gehört' states belonging, while the vocabulary only has rv:Possession; adding the exact word as rf:qualifier keeps the distinction in the source's wording without extending the model.

decisions.finding: The founder relation ('ihrem Gründer') is not expressed.
decisions.reason: The contract has no act or state type for founding, and rf:qualifier is meant for wording that qualifies the factoid's type or time, not a characterisation of the grantor.

decisions.finding: 'kraft seiner und der päpstlichen Gewalt' might be rf:ground instead of rf:qualifier.
decisions.reason: rf:ground is a reason the regest gives for the act; 'kraft ... Gewalt' names the authority under which it is done, which is no reason. The exact wording is kept either way.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:actor:22706:local:fuersten
findings.description: The local actor for the judging princes carries rdfs:label and rf:nameInSource "Fürstenspruch". That word names the verdict, not a group of persons; the regest never names the princes as actors. Using it as the actor's name in source misrepresents the wording that identifies the actor.
findings.proposal: Either drop the princes' reference and keep "Fürstenspruch" as rf:qualifier of the judgment, or keep the local group but note in the batch report that it is inferred from the compound noun and give it no rf:nameInSource.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22706:alienations
findings.description: "Veräußerungen" is typed rv:Grant without a recipient. The regest states that the predecessor alienated goods but not to whom or in what form; rv:Grant is the closest act type and does not overstate.
findings.proposal: None required; record that the vocabulary has no generic alienation type.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22706:judgment
findings.description: rf:refersToAct links the judgment to the alienations, but the judgment rules against them (entgegen). The link is correct in direction, but the oppositional relation is not expressible, and it must not be read as a confirmation of the alienations.
findings.proposal: Keep the link and add rf:qualifier "entgegen den Veräußerungen" to make the opposition explicit in the source's words.

decisions.finding: The judging princes are labelled and named 'Fürstenspruch', which names the verdict, not persons.
decisions.reason: 'Vor Friedrich wird ein Fürstenspruch gefällt' never names the princes; rf:nameInSource and rdfs:label must be the wording naming the actor, and inferring a group from a compound noun is not supported. The safe fix keeps the word on the judgment.

decisions.finding: rf:refersToAct to the alienations could be read as confirming them; the opposition 'entgegen' is not expressed.
decisions.reason: The judgment confirms inalienability 'entgegen den Veräußerungen seines Vorgängers Friedrich'. Without the exact wording the link reads neutrally or as approval; adding it as qualifier keeps the opposition in the source's words.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22707:earlier-act-konrad
findings.description: The passage says only that Friedrich acts in imitation of König Konrad (III.). Typing Konrad's act as rv:Confirmation is a plausible reading but not stated; the regest does not say what Konrad did. The qualifier "in Nachahmung" describes the relation of Friedrich's act to Konrad's, not Konrad's act itself, so it sits on the wrong factoid.
findings.proposal: Move rf:qualifier "in Nachahmung" to urn:regesta:22707:confirmation; keep the earlier act but type it with the most general act type the contract allows (rv:Confirmation is acceptable only if a reviewer accepts the inference), and record the gap that the earlier act's content is unstated.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22707:confirmation
findings.description: "ihre ... Güter" states that the goods belong to the monasteries. A rv:Possession state factoid could record this; the confirmation covers it implicitly.
findings.proposal: Optional: add a rv:Possession factoid with both monasteries as rv:Possessor.

decisions.finding: 'in Nachahmung' describes Friedrich's act, not Konrad's, and sits on the wrong factoid; the earlier act's type is inferred.
decisions.reason: In 'Friedrich bestätigt ... in Nachahmung König Konrads (III.) ihre ... Güter' the phrase qualifies Friedrich's confirmation. That Konrad's act was itself a confirmation is the natural reading of a confirmation made in imitation of him and stays, with the gap noted.

decisions.finding: Optionally add an rv:Possession factoid for 'ihre ... Güter'.
decisions.reason: The possessive stands inside the confirmed object; the guidelines do not require a separate state factoid, and a confirmation establishes no possession by itself.

unresolved.text: 'den König' and 'den Grafen' in the provision on Abgaben are modelled as FunctionalActors, not as the ruler and not as Goswin; whether 'den Grafen' means the Vogt Goswin is unresolved.

gaps.text: No actor for 'das Reich' as holder of 'die Rechte des Reiches'; no RightHolding factoid was built and the right is typed only with the top concept rv:LordshipRights.

The parties of 'die Streitigkeiten mit dem Vogt' other than Goswin are not stated; only Goswin is referenced as Participant. Goswin's Vogt office is recorded as OfficeHolding with qualifier 'Vogt' without its object.
rf:refersToAct links the confirmation to the envoys' written report on which it is based; the model has no distinct 'based on' relation.
No property for the evidentiary basis of an act (nach dem schriftlichen Bericht) distinct from refersToAct.
No role for the beneficiary share of a thing (den Hof) as opposed to an actor.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22708:confirmation
findings.description: rf:refersToAct links the confirmation to the envoys' report. The contract defines refersToAct for a later act such as a confirmation referring to an earlier act; read that way, the candidate implies that Friedrich confirms the report. The regest says he confirms the rights on the basis of the report (nach dem schriftlichen Bericht), which is a basis, not the object of the confirmation.
findings.proposal: Remove rf:refersToAct to urn:regesta:22708:envoy-report and add rf:qualifier "nach dem schriftlichen Bericht (scripti attestatione) seiner Gesandten" to the confirmation, or record the missing basis-of relation as a model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22708:envoy-report
findings.description: The envoys are Friedrich's (seiner Gesandten) and report to him; Friedrich is not referenced in the report factoid. The regest implies but does not state an addressee.
findings.proposal: Optional: add Friedrich as rv:Addressee with rf:nameInSource "seiner"; otherwise leave as is.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22708:provision-abgaben
findings.description: The provisions are passive (werden ... geregelt) and carry no grantor. This is faithful to the wording; Friedrich as grantor follows only from the main act via rf:partOf.
findings.proposal: None required.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:actor:22708:local:koenig
findings.description: "den König" in the revenue division is modelled as a functional actor rather than the shared ruler. This is defensible, since the share belongs to the king as office; it avoids asserting identity with Friedrich. Likewise "den Grafen" is not identified with Goswin, which the passage does not support.
findings.proposal: None required.

decisions.finding: rf:refersToAct to the envoys' report implies Friedrich confirms the report; it is only the basis.
decisions.reason: rf:refersToAct is defined as a later act referring to an earlier act of the same regest; it does not say 'confirms'. The object of the confirmation is given by rf:concerns (the rights of the Empire at Meerssen), and 'nach dem schriftlichen Bericht' does refer to that report, so the link is defensible. A dedicated basis property is a model gap.

decisions.finding: Optionally add Friedrich as rv:Addressee of the report.
decisions.reason: 'seiner Gesandten' implies but does not state to whom the report went; the contract does not require an inferred addressee.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22711:confirmation
findings.description: Waulsort is referenced as rv:Beneficiary. The confirmed subordination is a right of Waulsort over Hastière, so Waulsort is the party to whom something is confirmed, which the vocabulary defines as rv:Recipient. Beneficiary is not wrong but weaker than the passage allows.
findings.proposal: Use rv:Recipient for the Waulsort reference; keep Hastière in rf:concerns.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22711:privilege-lothar
findings.description: The two earlier privilege factoids carry only the grantor. The passage says the confirmation follows these privileges, so the earlier acts concern the same subordination; without rf:concerns and without Waulsort they are free-floating grants of unknown object. The rf:Grant type is a generic reading of 'Privilegien' that the passage does not narrow; this is acceptable, but the object link is recoverable. Same for urn:regesta:22711:privilege-konrad.
findings.proposal: Add rf:concerns <urn:regesta:22711:right-unterordnung> to both earlier act factoids, or record in the batch report that the object of the earlier privileges is left unstated on purpose.

findings.description: The witness list carries a stated kinship ('dominus Welf, der Oheim des Königs'). The guidelines exclude formulaic witness lists, so the omission is contract-conform, but a kinship word inside Z.: is not formulaic and would otherwise be an rv:Kinship factoid.
findings.proposal: No change under the frozen contract; report as a boundary question for the guidelines.

decisions.finding: Waulsort should be rv:Recipient instead of rv:Beneficiary.
decisions.reason: The passage names no dative recipient ('bestätigt ... die volle Unterordnung des Klosters Hastière (Hasteriensis) unter die Abtei Waulsort'); the confirmation is in Waulsort's favour, which rv:Beneficiary states without asserting receipt.

decisions.finding: The two earlier privilege factoids lack the object they concern.
decisions.reason: The confirmation of the subordination is made 'gemäß den Privilegien seiner Vorgänger, Lothar III. und Konrad III.', so the passage itself ties the earlier privileges to the same subordination; the right node already exists in the file.

commentary.t: Erwirkt von Wibald, der seit seiner Profeß in engen Beziehungen zu Waulsort stand, vgl. die Vorbemerkungen zu DL. III. 131 und DK. III. 251 sowie auch Hausmann, Reichskanzlei 234; für eine Mundierung durch Wibald spricht vor allem das in D nachgezeichnete Monogramm, das dem in dem von ihm mundierten DF. I. 1 (s. Reg.
) entspricht.

28; MG. DF. I. 9. Reg.: Wauters, Table chronol. 7/1, 255 zu Mai 5; Stumpf 3624.

Quoniam regię nostre .

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22712:kinship-heinrich
findings.description: The factoid makes Friedrich the kin of Duke Heinrich. In the passage 'seines Verwandten' follows directly on 'des dortigen Propstes Benno', so the possessive can grammatically point to Benno as well as to the sentence subject Friedrich. Regest convention favours Friedrich, but the second selector 'Friedrich bestätigt' only shows that Friedrich is the subject, not that the possessive refers to him; the register label 'Cousin Friedrich Barbarossas' may not be used as evidence. The reading is plausible but is an interpretation that the file does not mark.
findings.proposal: Keep the factoid only with the antecedent recorded as unresolved in the batch report, or give expert review the choice between Friedrich and Benno as second kin.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22712:right-obsorge
findings.description: 'Obsorge' of the bishop over the Stift is typed rv:LordshipRights. This is a defensible top-level choice; a more specific type does not exist in the scheme.
findings.proposal: None required.

findings.description: The witness list states several kinship relations (Lutolf and his sons, Hoger as brother of Lutolf, Rudolf de Capella and his son Ulrich). Omitted per the witness-list exclusion; noted as a boundary case because these are stated relations, not formulae.
findings.proposal: No change under the frozen contract.

decisions.reason: In 'auf Bitten Bischof Bernhards von Hildesheim, dessen Obsorge das Stift untersteht, des dortigen Propstes Benno und seines Verwandten' the regest uses 'dessen' for a non-subject antecedent and 'seines' for the sentence subject Friedrich; the candidate's reading follows this grammar and does not rest on the register label. The model cannot mark uncertainty inside a factoid; the residual doubt belongs to expert review, not to correction.

commentary.t: Zu Schrift und Diktat vgl. Diestelkamp, der auch eine genaue Beschreibung von A bietet. - Bei der Nennung Heinrichs des Löwen als Petent sind die Worte
Saxonie atque Bawarie

von späterer Hand im frei gelassenen Raum nachgetragen; er wurde damals von der Reichskanzlei noch nicht als Herzog von Bayern bezeichnet. Diestelkamp vermutet, daß der freie Raum für einen weiteren Petenten vorgesehen war. - Zum Inhalt vgl. Heinemann, Hildesheim (Quellen u. Darstell. zur Gesch. Niedersachsens 72, 1968) 216 f. - Zur Bedeutung des welfischen Vogtes Anno von Goslar vgl. Jordan, Goslar und das Reich, Niedersächs. Jb. f. LG 35 (1963) 62 ff., Heinemann, a. a. O. 237 ff. und Petke, Grafen von Wöltingerode-Wohldenberg (Veröff. d. Inst. f. hist. LF d. Univ. Göttingen 4, 1971) 305 ff.

The announced dispatch of a legate is an announcement of a future mission without an act type of its own; not extracted.
'stellt ihm die Kaiserkrönung in Aussicht' typed rv:Assurance with qualifier 'in Aussicht'; whether a prospect counts as an assurance needs expert review.
No sender or author role for rv:Communication.
No act type for a coronation or a coronation oath; the oath is approximated as rv:Assurance.

corrections.text: Added <urn:regesta:22713:election> (rf:ActFactoid, rv:Appointment) with evidence "die Botschaft von seiner Wahl", reference RI004-002-F000471 rv:Recipient nameInSource "seiner", rf:qualifier "Wahl"; no electors, no date, no rf:partOf.
Added rf:refersToAct <urn:regesta:22713:election> to <urn:regesta:22713:approbation>; approbation otherwise unchanged and now attributed to correction-g5.

Added <urn:regesta:22713:legate-announcement> (rf:ActFactoid, rv:Communication) with evidence "kündigt die baldige Entsendung eines Legaten an" and "Papst Eugen (III.) schreibt an König F(riedrich)", references E000589 rv:Participant and F000471 rv:Addressee, rf:qualifier "baldige", rf:partOf <urn:regesta:22713:letter>. No rv:Mission, no legate actor, no outcome.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22713:approbation
findings.description: The pope approbates 'diese Wahl', Friedrich's election, which the passage reports as an earlier act ('die Botschaft von seiner Wahl'). The guidelines require the earlier act as its own act factoid joined by rf:refersToAct from the confirmation. The candidate folds the election into the second evidence selector of the approbation and gives the approbation Friedrich as Recipient, so the earlier act is collapsed into its confirmation.
findings.proposal: Add an rf:ActFactoid of type rv:Appointment for the election (Friedrich as rv:Recipient, electors unnamed, no date) with evidence 'die Botschaft von seiner Wahl', and add rf:refersToAct from urn:regesta:22713:approbation to it.

findings.description: The announcement of a legate is omitted. It is an act of the letter that the contract can express as a communication part of the letter; modelling it as rv:Mission would overreach, since only the announcement is stated.
findings.proposal: Add an rv:Communication factoid (or rv:Assurance) with rf:partOf the letter, the pope as sender reference, Friedrich as rv:Addressee and rf:qualifier 'baldige'.

findings.description: The pope reports having heard good things about Friedrich from cardinal priest Oktavian. Oktavian has a register candidate in this packet (RI004-002-O000158) and is not referenced at all. The report is a communication from Oktavian to the pope that the contract can express.
findings.proposal: Add an rv:Communication factoid with Oktavian as sender (rv:Participant) and the pope as rv:Addressee, with rf:qualifier 'schon'.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22713:imperial-coronation-prospect
findings.description: 'in Aussicht stellen' is weaker than a Zusicherung. The qualifier 'in Aussicht' preserves the weakening, so the factoid does not overstate; the coronation itself is not given as rf:concerns.
findings.proposal: Optionally add rf:concerns to a node labelled 'die Kaiserkrönung'.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22713:letter
findings.description: The pope as writer is rv:Participant because the role scheme has no sender role. Consistent with the vocabulary, but the author of a communication is not distinguishable from other participants.
findings.proposal: None under the frozen contract.

decisions.finding: The election approbated by the pope is collapsed into the approbation instead of being its own earlier act.
decisions.reason: The passage reports the election as an earlier act ('die Botschaft von seiner Wahl') and then 'approbiert diese Wahl ausdrücklich'. The guidelines require the earlier act as its own act factoid joined by rf:refersToAct from the confirmation; rv:Appointment is the type the run uses for an election (cf. 22730).

decisions.finding: The announcement of a legate is omitted.
decisions.reason: 'kündigt die baldige Entsendung eines Legaten an' is a distinct act of the letter and in scope, but only the announcement is stated; an rv:Mission would assert a sending the passage does not report. The letter's other contents are already modelled as rv:Communication parts of the letter, so the same weak form is safe.

decisions.finding: The pope's report of having heard good things from cardinal priest Oktavian is omitted.
decisions.reason: 'als er schon von Kardinalpriester O(ktavian) Gutes über ihn gehört habe' is a subordinate clause explaining the pope's joy, not a dispositive act or a kinship, economic or legal relation; adding it would widen the scope beyond central passages.

decisions.finding: Optionally add rf:concerns to a node 'die Kaiserkrönung'.
decisions.reason: The guidelines reserve rf:concerns for a right, thing, place or community; a coronation is none of these, and the qualifier 'in Aussicht' with the evidence already carries the wording.

K. III. 181 (VU. I) und 245 (VU. II), D. Arn. 3 (VU. III), D. Hermanns 1 (VU. IV) und DK. III. 221 (VU. V), verfaßt von Wibald, mundiert vom Schreiber der DDK. III. 179, 181, 221 und 245; SI. D. findings.description: The witness list contains two non-formulaic legal acts: Sven receives the kingdom from the king's hand, Knut resigns it into the king's hand. They are in-scope legal relations and are expressible, but the guidelines exclude Z.: wholesale. The omission is contract-conform; the warning records that substantive content is lost by the rule. The same acts are covered in 22715 and may not be carried over.
findings.proposal: No change under the frozen contract; raise the witness-list boundary for the next contract.

decisions.reason: The passage confirms to Corvey 'ihm umfassend die von seinen Vorgängern verliehenen Rechte'; the rights confirmed to the monastery are those the predecessors granted to it, and the actor is the register community already used in the file.

decisions.reason: The guidelines exclude formulaic witness lists ('Z.:') wholesale and the reviewer proposes no change; the boundary question belongs to the next contract version, and the same acts must not be carried over from 22715.
