findings.subject: urn:regesta:22772:precedent-heinrich
findings.description: The passage says only that Friedrich acts 'nach dem Vorgang' of Heinrich (IV.) and Lothar (III.); it does not say whether the emperors granted or themselves confirmed the exemption. Typing both precedent factoids as rv:Grant with the emperors as Grantor asserts a grant the passage does not state. The same applies to urn:regesta:22772:precedent-lothar.
findings.proposal: Keep the two earlier act factoids and the qualifier 'nach dem Vorgang', but flag the act type as unresolved for expert review and report the lack of a neutral type for an unspecified earlier act as a model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22772:confirmation
findings.description: The object of the confirmation is the exemption of the monastery's people from all dues, but rf:concerns points only to the place Treviglio. The exemption itself is not represented as a right.
findings.proposal: Add a crm:E30_Right labelled with the exemption wording (closest type rv:UsageRights) to rf:concerns of the confirmation and the precedent factoids, and report the missing exemption type.

decisions.finding: The precedent acts of Heinrich (IV.) and Lothar (III.) are typed rv:Grant although the regest says only 'nach dem Vorgang'; applies equally to urn:regesta:22772:precedent-lothar.
decisions.reason: The passage 'nach dem Vorgang der Kaiser Heinrich (IV.) und Lothar (III.) die Befreiung ... von allen Abgaben' attests earlier acts about the exemption but not their kind. The candidate already keeps rf:qualifier 'nach dem Vorgang' and comments the unresolved reading; the act scheme has no neutral type for an earlier act of unstated kind, and rv:Confirmation would assert just as much as rv:Grant. No correction; gap recorded.

decisions.finding: The exemption that is the object of the confirmation has no right node; rf:concerns points only to the place Treviglio.
decisions.reason: The confirmed object is 'die Befreiung der Klosterleute zu Treviglio (Triuillio, qui dicitur Grasso) von allen Abgaben'. The contract can express it as a crm:E30_Right; since the vocabulary has no exemption type, only the top concept rv:UsageRights is safe, as used for the gaulum exemption in 22780.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22773:enfeoffment
findings.description: rf:refersToAct is defined for a confirmation or assurance referring to an earlier act. The enfeoffment follows the judgment ('nachdem') but does not confirm it. The 'erneut' implies an earlier enfeoffment that the regest does not report as an act, so the qualifier alone is adequate.
findings.proposal: Either drop rf:refersToAct or keep it with an explicit note that it expresses sequence, not confirmation.

decisions.finding: rf:refersToAct from the renewed enfeoffment to the judgment misuses a property meant for confirmations.
decisions.reason: rf:refersToAct is defined for 'a later act such as a confirmation or assurance', so the list is not exclusive. The regest ties the renewed enfeoffment to the judgment ('belehnt ... erneut ..., nachdem ... ein diesbezüglicher Spruch gefällt worden ist'); a reference from the later act to the earlier one the same regest reports is defensible and implies no date.

decisions.reason: N000177 is the packet's own register entry 'Niederaltaich ... // Mönche', matching the passage by name; the label 'einiger Mönche' and rf:nameInSource keep the restriction in the source wording. A regest-local group would discard a valid packet identification.

regests.lead: Friedrich bestätigt die Gründung des Klosters Alteburg (Aldenburg) bei der Burg Arnsburg durch den Reichsministerialen Konrad von Dreieichenhain (Hagen) und seine Gattin Luitgard mit Rat und Hilfe des Abtes Nikolaus von Siegburg als Tochterniederlassung dieser Abtei mit ihren einzeln angeführten Besitzungen, trifft Verfügungen über die Rechte des Vogtes, der stets der Gründersippe entnommen werden soll, und erklärt sich als zuständig für Klagen des Klosters gegen den Vogt.
regests.text: Friedrich bestätigt die Gründung des Klosters Alteburg (Aldenburg) bei der Burg Arnsburg durch den Reichsministerialen Konrad von Dreieichenhain (Hagen) und seine Gattin Luitgard mit Rat und Hilfe des Abtes Nikolaus von Siegburg als Tochterniederlassung dieser Abtei mit ihren einzeln angeführten Besitzungen, trifft Verfügungen über die Rechte des Vogtes, der stets der Gründersippe entnommen werden soll, und erklärt sich als zuständig für Klagen des Klosters gegen den Vogt. Z.: die Erzbischöfe Heinrich von Mainz, Arnold von Köln, die Bischöfe Gebhard von Würzburg, Gunther von Speyer, die Herzoge Friedrich (von Schwaben, der König), Heinrich (von Sachsen), Pfalzgraf Hermann (bei Rhein), die Grafen Gerhard von Nürings (Nuringis) und Bertholf von Nied (Nitha), Gottfried von Höchst (Hoste), Graf Heinrich von Hessen (Hassię), Propst Arnold (von St. Peter zu Mainz), (Dom)propst Hartmann (oder: Propst von St. Moritz zu Mainz), Propst Giselbert (wohl von Frankfurt) und die Ministerialen Salicho, Hartmud, Eckehard, Getto, Berthold, Werner, Konrad, Lutfrid und Wigand. - Arnoldus canc. vice Maguntini archiep. et archicanc. ; nach der Urkunde Erzbischof Heinrichs I. von Mainz von 1151, Acht, Mainzer UB. 2/1, 292 no 159, Exemplar A verfaßt von einem Siegburger Empfängerschreiber, der den Kontext mundierte, während A II. C im Protokoll die Worte Fridericus und rex in dem dafür frei gelassenen Raum einsetzte und das gesamte Eschatokoll hinzufügte; SI. 1. Ad hoc nutu .

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22774:confirmation
findings.description: The regest reports an earlier act, the foundation of Alteburg by Konrad von Dreieichenhain and his wife Luitgard with the advice and help of Abbot Nikolaus of Siegburg, which Friedrich confirms. The candidate does not model this act and instead lists the founders and the abbot as rv:Participant of Friedrich's confirmation, which misplaces them in an act they did not perform. The guidelines require a confirmation to yield two act factoids joined by rf:refersToAct; the extractor's note cites the missing foundation type, which is a real gap but does not license dropping the act.
findings.proposal: Add an earlier rf:ActFactoid for the foundation (closest type rv:Grant, flagged as a type gap) with Konrad and Luitgard as rv:Grantor, Abbot Nikolaus as rv:Participant with rf:qualifier 'mit Rat und Hilfe', the Alteburg community as rv:Recipient and the possessions in rf:concerns; link it from the confirmation with rf:refersToAct and remove the three Participant references from the confirmation.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22774:confirmation
findings.description: The filiation to Siegburg is kept only as a qualifier string; the abbey of Siegburg (packet candidate RI004-002-S000657) does not appear as an actor.
findings.proposal: Optionally add the Siegburg community as a reference; report the missing filiation relation as a model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22774:advocate-from-founder-kin
findings.description: Reading the founders' kin as rv:Beneficiary of the rule that the advocate is always to be taken from it is interpretive; the passage states a selection rule, not a benefit.
findings.proposal: Use rv:Participant for the Gründersippe, or keep Beneficiary with a note.

decisions.finding: The foundation of Alteburg, the earlier act Friedrich confirms, is collapsed into the confirmation; founders and the advising abbot are listed as participants of Friedrich's act.
decisions.reason: The regest reads 'Friedrich bestätigt die Gründung des Klosters Alteburg (Aldenburg) ... durch den Reichsministerialen Konrad von Dreieichenhain (Hagen) und seine Gattin Luitgard mit Rat und Hilfe des Abtes Nikolaus von Siegburg'. The guidelines require a confirmation of an earlier act to give two act factoids joined by rf:refersToAct, and Konrad, Luitgard and Nikolaus did not take part in Friedrich's confirmation. The missing foundation type does not license dropping the act; the closest act type rv:Grant with the exact word 'Gründung' in rf:qualifier is the safe approximation, as 22783 likewise models a foundation by an existing transfer type.

decisions.finding: Optionally add the Siegburg abbey as an actor for the filiation.
decisions.reason: 'als Tochterniederlassung dieser Abtei' states a filiation the contract has no state type or role for; the wording is kept as qualifier (after correction on the foundation factoid). The reviewer marks the addition as optional.

decisions.finding: The Gründersippe as rv:Beneficiary is interpretive; rv:Participant proposed.
decisions.reason: 'des Vogtes, der stets der Gründersippe entnommen werden soll' reserves the advocacy to the founders' kin, which is a provision in their favour; rv:Beneficiary ('Zu wessen Gunsten etwas geschieht') is a defensible reading.

commentary.t: Der Kontext des vorliegenden D. wurde in der Zeit der Vakanz des Thrones im Februar/März 1152 niedergeschrieben, wie sich aus der Freilassung des Namens und des Titels des Herrschers ergibt; die Zeugen sind ebenfalls auf diese Zeit zu beziehen (s. Reg.

). Vollendet und beglaubigt wurde das D. dann im Dezember 1152, vgl. dazu Küther a. a. O. 231 ff., Appelt, Wahl (FS. Wiesflecker, 1973) 39 ff. und die Vorbemerkung zu DF. I. 38. - Zur wörtlichen Übernahme des Passus der VU., der dem Kloster das Recht der Klage gegen den Vogt vor dem Erzbischof, d. h. nun nach Übernahme ins Diplom vor dem Konig einräumt, vgl. Falck, Klosterfreiheit, A. f. mittelrh. KG 8 (1956) 64 f. - Erzbischof Heinrich von Mainz ist ebenso wie die anderen genannten Zeugen (der König selbst wird als Herzog von Schwaben genannt) als Handlungszeuge aufzufassen, weshalb diese Urkunde nicht als Zeichen einer Annäherung zwischen dem König und dem Mainzer Metropoliten - so Simonsfeld, Jahrbücher 141 f. - gewertet werden darf, vgl. dazu Büttner, Heinrich von Mainz, ZKG 69 (1958) 265 f. und die Vorbemerkung zu DF. I. 38. - Das vorligende D. wird auch in einer Urkunde des Abtes Gerhard I. von Eberbach von 1174 Juli 16 erwähnt, ed. Acht, Mainzer UB. 2/2, 602 n
o

regests.lead: Friedrich feiert das Weihnachtsfest im Krönungsornat, und Graf Dietrich von Flandern trägt in feierlicher Prozession das Schwert vor ihm.
regests.text: Friedrich feiert das Weihnachtsfest im Krönungsornat, und Graf Dietrich von Flandern trägt in feierlicher Prozession das Schwert vor ihm. Am folgenden Tag verleiht er Graf Dietrich von Flandern in Anwesenheit und mit Zustimmung der weltlichen Fürsten (ducibus totius monarchiae cum satrapis adstantibus regique faventibus) nach Leistung des Lehnseides neben seinen Lehen auch die Oberhoheit über das Bistum Cambrai. Der abreisende Graf beauftragt seinen Neffen, Herzog Matthäus von Lothringen, mit der Förderung seiner Angelegenheiten, und dieser ruft einen Schreiber, der gemäß dem Wunsch des Grafen eine vom König zu besiegelnde Urkunde ausfertigt, die ihm allerorten Gehorsam verschaffen soll (epistolam ... ubicumque in locis provecta foret et lecta, obedirent comiti sine mora). Bischof Nikolaus von Cambrai, der von diesen Bestrebungen des flandrischen Grafen gehört hat, eilt herbei und kann mit Unterstützung der Erzbischöfe von Köln, Mainz und Trier sowie des Lütticher Bischofs vor dem König verhindern, daß die Urkunde Gültigkeit erlangt. Nur mit großer Mühe kann Friedrich dem Ausbruch von Feindseligkeiten zwischen dem erzürnt zurückgekehrten Grafen und dem Bischof Einhalt gebieten, indem er Dietrich die Einwilligung zu einem Waffenstillstand bis zum nächsten Pfingstfest abringt.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22775:enfeoffment
findings.description: The sentence reads most naturally as Friedrich granting Dietrich his fiefs and in addition the overlordship ('verleiht ... neben seinen Lehen auch'). The candidate treats the fiefs only as a pre-existing state without lord and lets the enfeoffment concern only the overlordship, so part of the grant's object is lost.
findings.proposal: Add urn:regesta:22775:lehen to rf:concerns of the enfeoffment; keep or drop the separate FeudalRelationship state, and mark the reading as ambiguous for expert review.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22775:document-drafted
findings.description: rf:partOf is for a provision or secondary act belonging to a main act. Matthäus summoning a scribe who drafts a charter is a subsequent act by another actor, not a provision of Dietrich's commission.
findings.proposal: Remove rf:partOf from the drafting factoid and keep it as an independent act.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:actor:22775:local:erzbischoefe
findings.description: Three distinct office holders (the archbishops of Köln, Mainz and Trier) are merged into one rf:FunctionalActor. FunctionalActor is meant for an actor determined by function, not for a collective of three individuals; the merge prevents later identification of each.
findings.proposal: Create three separate regest-local actors (archbishop of Köln, of Mainz, of Trier), each with its own reference; leave identification with the packet candidates to expert review since the passage gives no personal names.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22775:dispute-before-king
findings.description: The king is the authority before whom the bishop prevents the charter from gaining validity; rv:Addressee is a cautious reading. The outcome itself (validity prevented) has no factoid.
findings.proposal: No change required; report the outcome type as a model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22775:kinship-nephew
findings.description: Both actors carry rv:Kin, so the direction (Matthäus is the count's nephew) survives only in the qualifier 'Neffen' without telling whose nephew. This follows the guidelines but loses direction.
findings.proposal: No change under the current contract; report as model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22775:truce
findings.description: A truce between count and bishop is modelled as Dietrich's unilateral assurance with the bishop as Beneficiary; the passage describes a bilateral cessation of hostilities extracted by Friedrich.
findings.proposal: Keep as approximation with rv:Participant for the bishop, and report the truce type gap.

decisions.finding: The fiefs should be part of the enfeoffment's object, not only a pre-existing state.
decisions.reason: 'verleiht er Graf Dietrich ... neben seinen Lehen auch die Oberhoheit über das Bistum Cambrai' admits two readings: granting the fiefs and the overlordship, or granting the overlordship in addition to fiefs Dietrich already holds. The candidate's second reading is grammatically defensible and keeps the fiefs as a separate state without inferring a lord; the reviewer itself calls the passage ambiguous.

decisions.finding: rf:partOf links the drafting of the charter to Dietrich's commission, but it is a subsequent act, not a provision.
decisions.reason: rf:partOf is 'a provision or secondary act belonging to a main act ... such as the rights that come with a donation'. 'dieser ruft einen Schreiber, der ... eine vom König zu besiegelnde Urkunde ausfertigt' is a later act by Matthäus and a scribe, not a component of the commission.

decisions.finding: Three archbishops are merged into one rf:FunctionalActor.
decisions.reason: rf:FunctionalActor is one actor determined by office; 'der Erzbischöfe von Köln, Mainz und Trier' names three office holders as a plurality. Splitting into three actors would require labels that are not source wording ('Erzbischof von Mainz' does not occur), and the passage gives no personal names for a register identification. The safe fix is to type the plurality as a regest-local group, as the run does for 'der anwesenden Reichsfürsten' in 22773.

decisions.finding: Use rv:Participant instead of rv:Beneficiary for the bishop in the truce.
decisions.reason: The factoid reads the truce as Dietrich's consent extracted by Friedrich ('indem er Dietrich die Einwilligung zu einem Waffenstillstand ... abringt'); within that reading the bishop, against whom hostilities are halted, is the party in whose favour the consent is given. The approximation and the missing truce type are already documented.

commentary.t: Zu diesem ältesten erhaltenen Original einer
littera clausa
der Kanzlei Friedrichs I. und zu seiner Besiegelung und Faltung vgl. Bresslau, Urkundenlehre 2
, 588 Anm. 1; auf der Rückseite steht durch den Pergamentstreifen getrennt von der Hand des Notars A II. C die Adresse:
archiepiscopo Treuer/ensi

. Das Formular zeigt Anklänge an den päpstlichen Kanzleistil. - Die zeitliche Einreihung des Mandats ergibt sich aus der Rückkehr Hillins aus Italien im Sommer 1152 und aus der Nennung Rethers in Reg.
. - Die Mönche von Prüm hatten nach der Erkrankung ihres Abtes Gottfried unterstützt von Erzbischof Arnold von Köln (Knipping, Reg. Köln 2, n
o
) bei Friedrich dessen Absetzung und eine Neuwahl durchgesetzt (Cat. abb. Epternac. sec., MG. SS XXIII, 34, vgl. dazu Wibalds Schreiben an Arnold, Jaffé, Mon. Corb. 510 n
o
381), die auf Rether gefallen war, vgl. dazu auch Hilpisch, Hillin, A. f. mittelrh. KG 7 (1955) 14.

regests.text: Friedrich nimmt gemäß den Verfügungen König Konrads (III.) das Stift Floreffe in seinen Schutz und bestätigt ihm den Besitzstand, das Recht der freien Abtwahl und darüber hinaus die Kirche von Leffe mit allem Zubehör (ecclesiam scilicet sancte Marie, que Leffle dicitur, cum omnibus attinentiis suis, scilicet prepositura, templi custodia, oblationibus altaris et prebendarum redditibus), den Hof Fléchière (Fechire), die Hälfte des Allods von Mornimont (Mornigemont), die Höfe Marlange, Mariembourg (Uerofle) mit dem halben Zehent, Villers (Uileir), Coulonval (Ualle Columbina) und Eksel (Hecscele). Z.: Erzbischof Hillin von Trier, die Bischöfe Stephan von Metz, Ortlieb (Ortilief) von Basel, Heinrich von Lüttich, Nikolaus von Cambrai, die Äbte Wibald von Corvey und Stablo, Rether von Prüm, die Herzoge Heinrich von Sachsen, Welf von Spoleto, Matthäus von Lothringen, Gottfried von Löwen, die Grafen Heinrich von Namur, Dietrich von Flandern, Pfalzgraf Hermann bei Rhein. - Arnoldus can. vice Mogontini archiep. et archicanc. ; nach DK. III. 258 (VU. I) und der Urkunde Heinrichs des Blinden, des Grafen von Namur (Rousseau, Actes des comtes de Namur, 20 no 8; VU. II) offenbar mundiert von A II. D, dessen Gewohnheiten Zeugenankündigung und Eschatokoll entsprechen. Pie postulatio voluntatis .

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22777:right-leffe-revenues
findings.description: The revenue right covers only the altar offerings and prebend revenues; the provostship and church custody named in the same appurtenance list are not represented.
findings.proposal: Add a right node for 'prepositura, templi custodia' typed rv:ChurchRights, or extend the thing label of the church to the full appurtenance wording.

decisions.finding: Linking all confirmations, including the items after 'darüber hinaus', to Konrad's dispositions overreaches.
decisions.reason: 'gemäß den Verfügungen König Konrads (III.)' stands in the clause 'nimmt ... das Stift Floreffe in seinen Schutz'; whether it extends to the coordinated 'und bestätigt ihm ...' is a reading, and 'darüber hinaus' may mark additions beyond those dispositions. The contract cannot mark a link as ambiguous, so the safe fix is to keep the link only where the passage places it; the confirmations stay connected through rf:partOf to the protection.

decisions.finding: Coordinate confirmations and grants are linked by rf:partOf to the protection; drop partOf (22777) or keep only where subordinate (22779).
decisions.reason: rf:partOf covers 'a provision or secondary act belonging to a main act of the same regest'. The confirmations and grants of one diploma following the protection clause are defensibly secondary dispositions of that act, and the run applies the same pattern in 22780, 22783 and 22788. Dropping the links would leave the parts of one charter unconnected.

decisions.finding: The provostship and church custody of Leffe have no right node.
decisions.reason: The thing node 'die Kirche von Leffe mit allem Zubehör' already covers the appurtenances, and the full list stays in the evidence. A separate node for 'prepositura, templi custodia' is a refinement the contract does not require.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22779:right-toll-exemption
findings.description: The node is typed rv:Toll ('Zollrecht'), the right to levy tolls, while the passage grants exemption from all tolls and dues, the opposite relation. A query for toll rights would return this exemption as if the inhabitants held a toll.
findings.proposal: Type the node rv:UsageRights (top concept) and report the missing exemption type as model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22779:confirmation-donations
findings.description: The confirmations and grants are coordinate acts of the charter rather than provisions of the protection; rf:partOf to the protection overstates their dependence. Applies to all partOf links in this file.
findings.proposal: Keep partOf only where a clause is clearly subordinate, or accept it as a project convention.

decisions.finding: Coordinate confirmations and grants are linked by rf:partOf to the protection; drop partOf (22777) or keep only where subordinate (22779).
decisions.reason: rf:partOf covers 'a provision or secondary act belonging to a main act of the same regest'. The confirmations and grants of one diploma following the protection clause are defensibly secondary dispositions of that act, and the run applies the same pattern in 22780, 22783 and 22788. Dropping the links would leave the parts of one charter unconnected.

decisions.finding: The exemption from tolls is typed rv:Toll, the right to levy tolls.
decisions.reason: The passage grants 'die Befreiung der Bewohner der Stadt Gembloux von allen Zöllen und Abgaben im Reich'. rv:Toll ('Zollrecht') denotes the opposite relation and would return the inhabitants as holders of a toll. The top concept rv:UsageRights is expressible and does not assert a levy right.

commentary.t: Ob die im Text erwähnten Verleihungen Kaiser Ottos und des Bischofs von Lüttich mit dem gefälschten DO. I. 82 und einer Bischofsurkunde von etwa 1018-1021 (Roland a. a. O. 35 n
o

o

59) erfahren; ein diesbezügliches Diplom Konrads III. ist nicht erhalten. - Zur Vogtei des Klosters, die dem Herzog von Löwen zustand, vgl. Vollmer, Territorialpolitik, masch. phil. Diss. (Freiburg i. Br. 1951) 268.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22780:bestaetigung-gaulum
findings.description: The passage states that the Count of Flanders habitually and unlawfully levies the gaulum. This is a central legal relation with an actor, and it is entirely absent: neither the count nor the contested levy appears. The contract could at least record the count as a reference on the exemption factoid and keep 'widerrechtlich einzuheben pflegt' in exact wording.
findings.proposal: Add a regest-local actor 'der Graf von Flandern' (the passage gives no personal name, so the candidate RI004-002-D000242 is left to expert review) and either a reference on bestaetigung-gaulum with rv:Participant and rf:qualifier 'widerrechtlich einzuheben pflegt', or a separate StateFactoid recording the habitual levy with that qualifier; report the missing wrongful-exaction type.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22780:bestaetigung-immunitaet
findings.description: The partial confirmations of immunity and royal protection carry no references, so grantor and recipient are recoverable only through rf:partOf. Their evidence fragments name no actor.
findings.proposal: Add Friedrich as rv:Grantor and the church of Cambrai as rv:Recipient to both factoids.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22780:rechte
findings.description: The generic 'Rechte' is typed rv:LordshipRights although the passage does not characterise them; the shape forces a type.
findings.proposal: Keep with a note, and report the lack of an unspecified right type.

decisions.finding: The relative clause naming the Count of Flanders as habitual unlawful collector of the gaulum is omitted.
decisions.reason: 'die der Graf von Flandern widerrechtlich einzuheben pflegt' states a contested levy, but the contract has neither an act or state type for a wrongful exaction nor a role for an adverse party. A rv:Participant reference on the confirmation would assert that the count takes part in confirming the exemption, and no state type (Possession, RightHolding, Obligation) renders an unlawful levy without changing its meaning. No correction; the wrongful-levy type and the adverse-party role are recorded as gaps. The wording remains retrievable from the source.

decisions.finding: The partial confirmations of immunity and royal protection carry no references.
decisions.reason: Their evidence 'insbesondere die Immunität' and 'den Königsschutz' names no actor, and grantor and recipient follow from rf:partOf to urn:regesta:22780:bestaetigung, the pattern the run also uses for the sub-confirmations of 22783. The contract does not require references on every factoid.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22781:burg-homburg
findings.description: The regest states that Duke Matthäus of Lorraine had wrongfully usurped the castle. The candidate omits this clause and the actor, citing the lack of a type for wrongful seizure. The contract could express it as a StateFactoid rv:Possession (defined neutrally as possession 'wie das Regest es sagt') with Matthäus as rv:Possessor and the exact wording as qualifier. Matthäus matches the packet candidate RI004-002-M000670 by name and title.
findings.proposal: Add a StateFactoid rv:Possession concerning the castle with a reference to urn:regesta:actor:RI004-002-M000670 (rv:Possessor, nameInSource 'Herzog Matthäus von Lothringen') and rf:qualifier 'unrechtmäßig usurpiert'; report the usurpation act type as model gap.

decisions.finding: The usurpation of Homburg by Duke Matthäus, half of the regest, is omitted together with its actor.
decisions.reason: 'die Burg Homburg, die Herzog Matthäus von Lothringen unrechtmäßig usurpiert hat' is central and in scope (a legal relation to a castle). The act type for usurpation is missing, but the resulting holding is expressible as rv:Possession, defined 'wie das Regest es sagt', with the exact wording 'unrechtmäßig usurpiert' as qualifier so that no lawful possession is asserted. 'Herzog Matthäus von Lothringen' matches the packet candidate RI004-002-M000670 'Matthäus // Herzog von (Ober-)Lothringen' by name and title.

commentary.t: DF. I. 44, das Simonsfeld, Jahrbücher 150, noch unbekannt war, ist der einzige Beleg für den Aufenthalt in Metz. Die Übertragung der Vogtei an Wibald persönlich erfolgte am Todestag des kinderlosen Obervogtes Heinrich II. von Laroche. Nach dem schrittweisen Zurückdrängen des Einflusses des Vogtes war es Wibald damit gelungen, die ursprünglich rein grundherrliche Basis seiner Herrschaft auszuweiten; vgl. Wehlt, Reichsabtei (Veröff. d. M.-Planck-Inst. f. Gesch. 28, 1970) 228. Parisse, La noblesse Lorraine 2, 712 ff. macht wahrscheinlich, daß Friedrich um diese Zeit Herzog Matthäus von Lothringen die Grafschaft Toul zugesprochen hat, vgl. Reg.

I) und des Privilegs Paschals II. von 1106 (JL. 6072, Germ. pont. 3/3, 54 no 1; VU. II), wahrscheinlich verfaßt und geschrieben von A II. D. Felicius agi res .

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22783:recht-vogtwahl
findings.description: The right to choose the Vogt is typed rv:Advocacy, which the vocabulary defines as the protective lordship itself. The passage describes a right of selection over the advocate, closer to a church right than to holding the advocacy.
findings.proposal: Consider rv:ChurchRights for the election right; expert question for the right-type hierarchy.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22783:stiftung
findings.description: The foundation is typed rv:Donation with the monastery as recipient of its own foundation. The extractor flags it as the closest type; the reading is defensible but the recipient role is strained.
findings.proposal: Keep as is pending a foundation type; alternatively give the monastery rv:Beneficiary.

decisions.finding: The right to choose the Vogt is typed rv:Advocacy; rv:ChurchRights proposed.
decisions.reason: 'der auch das Recht hat, den Vogt zu wählen' is a right concerning the advocacy; rv:Advocacy is a defensible placement, and the hierarchy of right types is explicitly reserved for expert review in the vocabulary. Neither concept is clearly more correct.

decisions.finding: The monastery as rv:Recipient of its own foundation is strained; rv:Beneficiary as alternative.
decisions.reason: The reviewer recommends keeping it pending a foundation type. Under the approximating transfer type the founded house is the one to which the foundation is made over; the same choice is prescribed for 22774 above for consistency.

commentary.t: Die Bestimmung über die freie Vogtwahl wurde von JL. 6072 (VU. II) übernommen, obwohl Herzog Friedrich von Schwaben im Jahre 1105 festgestellt hatte, daß die Vogtei dem jeweiligen Inhaber des Hohenstaufen und des Herzogtums Schwaben zustehen solle (Würdtwein, Nova Subsidia 6, 290). - Es ist durchaus möglich, daß sich Friedrich damals auch in Oberehnheim aufgehalten hat. Zum Itinerar dieser Zeit vgl. Simonsfeld, Jahrbücher 150 Anm. 2 und Opll, Itinerar 10. - Zu den Vorfahren Friedrichs vgl. Maschke, Staufer, 17 ff. und Klebel, Hohenstaufen, ZGORh 102 = N. F. 63 (1954) 139 ff.

findings.description: The rebuilding of the house, the advice of clerics behind it and Burchard of Strasbourg's assistance in the re-establishment and the introduction of the Augustinian rule are omitted. The contract has no rebuilding type, but the advice could be kept as rf:ground and Burchard (candidate B001563) as a rv:Participant reference, for instance on an rv:Enactment or the appointment factoid, and the omission should at least be reported as a gap.
findings.proposal: Add a factoid for the re-establishment (or report it as a model gap) with Friedrich as Grantor, Burchard (urn:regesta:actor:RI004-002-B001563) as Participant, rf:ground 'auf Anraten geistlicher Personen', and the community of Hohenburg in rf:concerns.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22784:appointment-rilint
findings.description: The second selector 'Friedrich läßt' belongs to the rebuilding clause, not to the entrusting of the leadership. It identifies the grantor but supports a different act.
findings.proposal: Use 'Friedrich läßt auf Anraten geistlicher Personen das von seinem Vater beinahe gänzlich zerstörte Chorfrauenstift in Hohenburg' only for a rebuilding factoid; for the appointment the subject 'Friedrich' alone suffices.

decisions.finding: The rebuilding of Hohenburg on clerical advice, the father's destruction and Bishop Burchard's help with the re-establishment and the Augustinian rule are omitted.
decisions.reason: The passage 'Friedrich läßt auf Anraten geistlicher Personen das von seinem Vater beinahe gänzlich zerstörte Chorfrauenstift in Hohenburg ... wieder aufbauen' and 'der bei der Wiedererrichtung des Stiftes und der Einführung der Augustinerregel Bischof Burchard von Straßburg behilflich ist' is central, but no act type of the vocabulary (Grant, Restitution, Enactment, Appointment) expresses rebuilding, re-establishment, the introduction of a rule or destruction without changing the historical meaning. Attaching Burchard to the appointment of Rilint would misplace him, since his help concerns the re-establishment. No correction; the gaps are recorded.

decisions.finding: The second selector 'Friedrich läßt' belongs to the rebuilding clause.
decisions.reason: The appointment 'vertraut die Leitung der Äbtissin Rilint an' has its subject only in the coordinated opening 'Friedrich läßt'; the guidelines allow a second selector where a role rests on a different passage, and this selector supports the grantor reference.

regests.lead: Friedrich bestätigt dem Abt Berthold des von den Vorfahren des Grafen Eberhard auf seinem Allod gegründeten Klosters Altdorf im Elsaß [in quodam suę proprietatis allodio, quod dicitur Altorph, in quo suus avus et pater ipsius Hvgo abbatiam in honore sacratissimi marthiris Christi construxit Cyriaci in provincia Alsatia in pago quoque Northgowe in comitatu predicti quondam Everhardi, nunc autem heredis sui Hvgonis comitis (von Dagsburg) sito ], Markt, Münze, Schenke und Zoll (fas, ius et potestatem mercatum, monetam, tabernam et theloneum publicum habendi, construendi et legitime faciendi), wie sie einst Kaiser Otto (III.) dem Grafen Eberhard verliehen hatte, und alle anderen Stiftungen der Gründerfamilie.
regests.text: Friedrich bestätigt dem Abt Berthold des von den Vorfahren des Grafen Eberhard auf seinem Allod gegründeten Klosters Altdorf im Elsaß [in quodam suę proprietatis allodio, quod dicitur Altorph, in quo suus avus et pater ipsius Hvgo abbatiam in honore sacratissimi marthiris Christi construxit Cyriaci in provincia Alsatia in pago quoque Northgowe in comitatu predicti quondam Everhardi, nunc autem heredis sui Hvgonis comitis (von Dagsburg) sito ], Markt, Münze, Schenke und Zoll (fas, ius et potestatem mercatum, monetam, tabernam et theloneum publicum habendi, construendi et legitime faciendi), wie sie einst Kaiser Otto (III.) dem Grafen Eberhard verliehen hatte, und alle anderen Stiftungen der Gründerfamilie. Verstöße sollen mit dem gleichen Königsbann wie im Falle des Mainzer, Kölner und Straßburger Marktes geahndet werden. Z.: Erzbischof Arnold von Köln, Bischof Ortlieb von Basel, die Äbte Wibald und Corvey (Corbeigensis), Egelolf von Murbach Morbacensis, die Herzoge Heinrich von Sachsen, Berthold von Burgund, Pfalzgraf Otto von Wittelsbach, Graf Siegbert von Frankenburg, der erwähnte Hugo (von Dagsburg), Vogt von Altdorf (memoratus Hugo eiusdemque loci advocatus). - Arnoldus canc. vice Mogontini archiep. et archicanc ; in Anlehnung an den Rechtsinhalt eines Deperditums Ottos III. (B.-Uhlirz, Reg. no 1322; VU.) geschrieben von A II. D; SP. D. Noverit omnium tam .

decisions.finding: The heir relation of Count Hugo (von Dagsburg) to Eberhard is not extracted; a rv:Kinship factoid with qualifier 'heredis' is proposed.
decisions.reason: 'in comitatu predicti quondam Everhardi, nunc autem heredis sui Hvgonis comitis (von Dagsburg)' states succession as heir in a locating clause, not a kinship word; recording it as rv:Kinship would infer a genealogy the guidelines forbid. The contract has no heir role or succession state type. No correction; gap recorded.

decisions.finding: The foundation of Altdorf by Eberhard's ancestors is not recorded as an earlier act, unlike in 22783.
decisions.reason: Friedrich confirms 'Markt, Münze, Schenke und Zoll ... wie sie einst Kaiser Otto (III.) dem Grafen Eberhard verliehen hatte'; the foundation is a descriptive participle of the monastery, not the object of the confirmation, and that earlier act is already modelled. The foundation is therefore not central, and the contract lacks a foundation type. The ancestor relation from the same clause is kept.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22787:enactment-befreiung
findings.description: 'befreit es' takes a neuter antecedent and refers to the monastery of Peterlingen, not to the court (der Hof, masculine) at Kerzers. The candidate restricts the exemption from all advocacy claims to the court and names no beneficiary, so it states a narrower act than the passage does.
findings.proposal: Set rf:concerns to the monastery (urn:regesta:actor:RI004-002-P000278:community) or add it as rv:Beneficiary, and remove urn:regesta:22787:thing-hof-kerzers from this factoid.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22787:judgment-vogtei-kerzers
findings.description: The ruler's denial rests on a judgment of the princes. Keeping 'auf Grund eines Fürstenspruches' only as rf:ground collapses the princes' sentence into the ruler's act and makes Friedrich the sole rv:Judge.
findings.proposal: Add an undated rv:Judgment factoid for the princes' sentence with a functional actor 'Fürsten' as rv:Judge, linked from the ruler's act by rf:refersToAct; keep the ground literal.

findings.description: The packet has a register entry for the abbot of Cluny (C000775, 'Abt'). The candidate uses a local functional actor instead, which suits 'und seine Nachfolger'; in 22783 the analogous abbot of Conques got the register IRI. The run treats the two cases differently.
findings.proposal: Keep the functional actor and, per the guideline on individual holders, consider an additional reference to urn:regesta:actor:RI004-002-C000775 for the present abbot.

decisions.finding: 'befreit es' refers to the monastery, not to the court at Kerzers.
decisions.reason: In 'die Vogtei über den Hof des Klosters Peterlingen zu Kerzers ... ab, befreit es von allen vogteirechtlichen Ansprüchen' the neuter pronoun can refer to 'Klosters Peterlingen' or to the place name 'Kerzers', which is neuter in German. The reviewer's argument from gender overlooks the place name, and the immediate context (the advocacy over the court is denied, then 'es' is freed from advocacy claims) supports the candidate's reading. The reading stays open for expert review.

decisions.finding: The princes' sentence is collapsed into rf:ground; a separate rv:Judgment factoid with a functional actor 'Fürsten' is proposed.
decisions.reason: 'auf Grund eines Fürstenspruches' is a reason the regest gives for Friedrich's act, which is exactly what rf:ground records in exact wording. The passage names no princes; creating a judging actor from the compound 'Fürstenspruch' would add an actor the text does not name. Friedrich pronounces the denial ('spricht ... ab'), so rv:Judge stands.

decisions.finding: Consider an additional reference to the register entry C000775 for the present abbot of Cluny.
decisions.reason: The guideline adds an individual holder only 'where the passage names an individual holder too'. 'der Abt von Cluny und seine Nachfolger' names no individual, and C000775 is an office entry without a personal name, so it cannot be matched by name and title.

decisions.finding: The confirmation of the property names no recipient.
decisions.reason: In 'bestätigt dem Kloster das ... Vorrecht ... und verbrieft den zum Teil namentlich angeführten Besitzstand' the dative 'dem Kloster' governs both coordinated verbs. The recipient is expressible with the identification already used on urn:regesta:22787:confirmation-vorrecht, and the guidelines allow a second selector where a role rests on a different passage.

regests.lead: Friedrich nimmt die Besitzungen der Domkanoniker zu Besançon (matris ecclesiae sancti Ioannis) in seinen Schutz, unterstellt sie ausschließlich seiner Vogtei, bestätigt ihnen die Freiheit der Orte Cully (Cusliacum) und Riex (Roaldum) von allen Abgaben an die Dienstmannen zu Lutry (a ministris de Lustriaco), den Anteil an der Münze (Tertiam etiam partem Bisuntinae monetae cum custodia ferramentorum, quibus ipsa cuditur, ita quod ipsi habeant mediam partem et archiepiscopus aliam et neutri parti sine alia cudere liceat) sowie das Geleitrecht in der Stadt (conductum in civilate) und erneuert ihnen die Immunitätsverleihungen seiner Vorgänger bei Festsetzung einer Strafe von 70 Pfund für einen Freien bzw. ebensovielen Schlägen für einen Unfreien (si liber est, septuaginta libris legalem bannum componat, si vero servus, tot ictus accipiat).

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22788:strafe
findings.description: The penalty is two conditional rules: 70 Pfund for a free man, as many blows for an unfree man. The candidate puts four rf:amount and four rf:condition literals on one factoid, so the graph no longer says which amount applies under which condition and admits the reading of 70 Pfund for an unfree man.
findings.proposal: Split into two rv:Enactment factoids partOf the renewal: one with rf:condition 'für einen Freien' and rf:amount '70 Pfund', one with rf:condition 'für einen Unfreien' and rf:qualifier 'ebensovielen Schlägen' (a corporal penalty is not an amount).

findings.proposal: Keep, or drop the reference and keep them in the evidence; report the missing role.

decisions.finding: Four amounts and four conditions on one factoid lose which penalty applies under which condition.
decisions.reason: The passage sets two conditional rules: 'Strafe von 70 Pfund für einen Freien bzw. ebensovielen Schlägen für einen Unfreien (si liber est, septuaginta libris legalem bannum componat, si vero servus, tot ictus accipiat)'. On one node the graph admits 70 Pfund for an unfree man. Two enactment factoids keep each amount with its condition. 'ebensovielen Schlägen' is a counted quantity in its historical unit and may stay rf:amount.

decisions.finding: The Dienstmannen of Lutry as rv:Participant overstate their part; keep or drop.
decisions.reason: 'von allen Abgaben an die Dienstmannen zu Lutry' makes them the party to whom dues are no longer owed. rv:Participant is the vocabulary's declared fallback ('Beteiligt, ohne dass das Regest eine bestimmtere Rolle trägt'); dropping the reference would lose the actor. No correction; the missing role for an adversely affected party is recorded.

commentary.t: Zu den verlorenen Königsurkunden vgl. die Vorbemerkung zu DF. I. 49 und Herkenrath, in: WdF 390 (1975) 343. Bei den genannten
ministri

von Lutry handelt es sich nicht um königliche, wie das gefälschte DH. III. 389 angibt, sondern um solche des Bischofs von Lausanne, vgl. dazu die Urkunde Bischof Ortliebs von Basel von 1154 Juli 10, ed. Trouillat, Mon. de Bâle 1, 324 n
o
211; Sources du droit de Vaud B 1, ed. Anex-Cabanis- Poudret, Samml. Schweizer. Rechtsqu. 19, 1977, 33 n
o
39; Hidber 2, n
o

2008. Verschiedene stilistische Eigentümlichkeiten, aber auch die Androhung körperlicher Züchtigung unfreier Verletzer der Rechte der Kirche deuten darauf hin, daß es sich bei DF. I. 49 um Empfängerdiktat handelt. Die Goldbulle an Seidenfäden wird in C erwähnt.

ecclesiae sancti Ioannis
) wurde im Privileg Papst Lucius’ III. von 1185 Februar 5, Verona bestätigt, vgl. dazu Baaken – Schmidt, Papstregesten 1124–1198, Teil 4/Lfg. 2: 1184–1185, Nr. 1460.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22789:bestaetigung
findings.description: The toll collector of St. Paul is the person over whom the house holds jurisdiction, not a participant in the confirmation. As rv:Participant he appears to take part in the act.
findings.proposal: Move the jurisdiction into its own Confirmation factoid partOf the main confirmation and drop the Participant reference, reporting that the contract lacks a role for the subject of a jurisdiction.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22789:bestaetigung
findings.description: The old customs, the inhabitants' freedom from distraint and oppression and the judicial clarification of unlawful claims have no rf:concerns node and no factoid of their own; the inhabitants as beneficiaries are lost. 22783 and 22788 split such items into partOf factoids.
findings.proposal: Add partOf Confirmation factoids for the customs, the inhabitants' freedom (inhabitants as a local community with rv:Beneficiary) and the judicial clarification.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22789:vorbild-vorgaenger
findings.description: 'nach dem Vorbild seiner Vorgänger' implies earlier confirmations; recording them as an undated earlier Confirmation is acceptable, but it has no recipient and its evidence also covers the present act.
findings.proposal: Narrow the evidence to 'nach dem Vorbild seiner Vorgänger' and add the Stift as rv:Recipient.

decisions.finding: The toll collector of St. Paul is the subject of a jurisdiction, not a participant of the confirmation.
decisions.reason: 'die Gerichtsbarkeit über den Zöllner von St. Paul' makes him the person subject to the confirmed jurisdiction. The contract has no role for that relation; rv:Participant is the declared fallback and the right node keeps the exact wording. Dropping the reference would lose the register identification B001873. No correction; gap recorded.

decisions.finding: The customs, the inhabitants' freedom and the judicial clarification have no node and no factoid; the inhabitants as beneficiaries are lost.
decisions.reason: 'die Freiheit der Bewohner von Verpfändungen oder Bedrückungen wegen Nichtleistung städtischer Dienste' names a beneficiary group distinct from the recipient, which cannot be carried by the main confirmation without misattributing the role; it is expressible as a partial confirmation as in 22783 and 22788, typed like the comparable 'Freiheit ... von Bedrückungen' in 22783. 'die alten Gewohnheiten des Stiftes' and 'die gerichtliche Klärung unrechtmäßiger Besitzansprüche' have no fitting right type and would need an arbitrary type, so they stay only in the evidence.

decisions.finding: Narrow the evidence to 'nach dem Vorbild seiner Vorgänger' and add the Stift as rv:Recipient.
decisions.reason: 'nach dem Vorbild seiner Vorgänger' alone does not carry the act type; the current selector includes the object that makes it a confirmation, as the guideline on the shortest passage carrying type and roles allows. Adding the Stift as recipient of the predecessors' acts would assert a recipient the passage only implies.

einsetzte. Die Überlieferung in der sekundären und unvollständigen Abschrift Ms. Chifflet 9 f. 129' der Stadtbibliothek Besançon (
XV mensis februarii

) widerspricht wieder dem Kanzleibrauch und dürfte eine gelehrte Emendation darstellen. Zum Besitz von Saint-Paul vgl. die Gründungsurkunde des Stiftes durch Erzbischof Hugo von 1044 (Guillaume, Hist. de Salins 2, pr. 14).

); Vidimus des Offizials der Kurie von Besançon von 1532 April 29, Departementalarchiv Besançon (C); Einzelabschrift (17. Jh.), C beiliegend, ebenda (D). Drucke: Böhmer, Acta imp. 87 n

regests.text: Friedrich schließt mit Papst Eugen III. durch die päpstlichen Unterhändler, die Kardinäle Gregor von S. Maria in Trastevere, Ubald von S. Prassede, Berhard von S. Clemente, Oktavian von S. Cecilia, Roland von S. Marco, Gregor von S. Angelo, Wido von S. Maria in Porticu sowie Abt Bruno von Chiaravalle (Caravalle) und die königlichen Unterhändler, die Bischöfe Anselm von Havelberg und Hermann von Konstanz sowie die Grafen Ulrich von Lenzburg, Guido Guerra, Guido von Biandrate folgenden Vorvertrag: 1) Der König wird durch den Eid eines Reichsministerialen und persönlichen Handschlag (rex iurare faciet unum de ministerialibus regni in anima regis et ipse idem manu propria data fide) in die Hand des päpstlichen Legaten dem Papst geloben, weder Waffenstillstand noch Frieden (nec trevam nec pacem) mit den Römern und Roger von Sizilien ohne freie Zustimmung der römischen Kirche und des Papstes Eugen (III.) oder seiner Nachfolger, die den Vertrag mit ihm bewahren wollen, zu schließen und nach Kräften seines Reiches daran zu arbeiten, die Römer zu unterwerfen, wie vor 100 Jahren. 2) Die Gerechtsame des Papsttums und die Regalien des hl. Petrus (honorem papatus et regalia beati Petri) wird er als Schutzvogt der römischen Kirche nach seinem Vermögen bewahren und verteidigen und das derzeit Entfremdete nach Kräften wiederzugewinnen helfen und das Wiedergewonnene dann verteidigen. 3) Auch dem griechischen Herrscher wird er keine Gebiete diesseits des Meeres zugestehen und im Falle einer Invasion sich nach Kräften bemühen, ihn möglichst rasch zu vertreiben. 4) Der Papst verspricht kraft seines apostolischen Amtes gemeinsam mit den genannten Kardinälen in Gegenwart der königlichen Unterhändler, er werde den nach Rom zur Kaiserkrönung kommenden Konig (venientem pro plenitudine coronę suę), soweit es an ihm liegt, ohne Schwierigkeit und Widerspruch krönen und, wie es sein Amt gebiete, zur Bewahrung und Vermehrung der königlichen Gerechtsame beitragen. 5) Wer sich anmaßen sollte, die Gerechtsame des Reiches (iusticiam et honorem regni) zu mißachten, den wird der Papst, auf Ersuchen des Königs, zur Genugtuung ermahnen und nötigenfalls exkommunizieren. 6) Dem griechischen Herrscher wird auch der Papst diesseits des Meeres kein Land zugestehen und im Falle einer Invasion sich nach Kräften bemühen, ihn möglichst rasch zu vertreiben. - Hęc est forma .

On p5-exkommunikation added rf:condition 'Wer sich anmaßen sollte, die Gerechtsame des Reiches (iusticiam et honorem regni) zu mißachten'; existing conditions and references kept; producer correction-g8.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22791:p3-griechen-koenig
findings.description: 'im Falle einer Invasion' conditions only the second promise (to expel the Greek ruler). On the single factoid it also conditions the unconditional promise not to concede territory this side of the sea, which the passage does not support. The same defect applies to urn:regesta:22791:p6-griechen-papst.
findings.proposal: Split clause 3 and clause 6 each into two Assurance factoids: the non-concession without condition, and the expulsion with rf:condition 'im Falle einer Invasion'.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22791:p1-kein-frieden
findings.description: The Romans, Roger of Sicily and the Greek ruler are the third parties the promises are directed against; rv:Participant suggests they take part in the treaty. Applies also to p1-roemer-unterwerfen, p3 and p6.
findings.proposal: Drop the Participant references or replace them by a role for an opposing or excluded party once the vocabulary has one; report as model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22791:p4-kroenung
findings.description: The pope promises together with the named cardinals in the presence of the royal negotiators; the cardinals, who are co-promisors, are not referenced.
findings.proposal: Add the seven cardinals (G000972, H001250, B000622, O000158, R000856, G000973, G001157) as rv:Grantor references on p4.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22791:p5-exkommunikation
findings.description: The triggering condition of clause 5, that someone presumes to disregard the rights of the realm, is not kept as rf:condition; only 'auf Ersuchen des Königs' and 'nötigenfalls' are.
findings.proposal: Add rf:condition 'Wer sich anmaßen sollte, die Gerechtsame des Reiches (iusticiam et honorem regni) zu mißachten'; consider rv:Petitioner for the king, since the admonition happens 'auf Ersuchen des Königs'.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22791:vorvertrag
findings.description: All negotiators carry rv:Negotiator, so the distinction between papal and royal negotiators is kept only in the evidence.
findings.proposal: None within the contract; see model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22791:p2-regalien
findings.description: The capacity 'als Schutzvogt der römischen Kirche' is kept as a qualifier, which is adequate; it is not an office holding the passage asserts independently.
findings.proposal: None.

decisions.finding: 'im Falle einer Invasion' conditions only the expulsion promise but sits on a factoid that also holds the unconditional non-concession; the same applies to urn:regesta:22791:p6-griechen-papst.
decisions.reason: 'Auch dem griechischen Herrscher wird er keine Gebiete diesseits des Meeres zugestehen und im Falle einer Invasion sich nach Kräften bemühen, ihn möglichst rasch zu vertreiben' contains two promises, of which only the second is conditional; clause 6 is built identically. A condition on the combined factoid conditions the whole, which the passage does not support.

decisions.finding: The Romans, Roger of Sicily and the Greek ruler, against whom the promises are directed, appear as rv:Participant; applies also to p1-roemer-unterwerfen, p3 and p6.
decisions.reason: In 'weder Waffenstillstand noch Frieden ... mit den Römern und Roger von Sizilien' and the Greek-ruler clauses these actors are the third parties the promises concern. The vocabulary has no role for an opposing or excluded party, rv:Participant is its declared fallback, and dropping the references would lose identified actors. No correction; gap recorded.

decisions.finding: The cardinals who promise together with the pope are not referenced.
decisions.reason: 'Der Papst verspricht kraft seines apostolischen Amtes gemeinsam mit den genannten Kardinälen' makes the cardinals co-promisors. 'den genannten Kardinälen' refers back to the seven cardinals named in the same regest and already identified with packet candidates in this file; Abbot Bruno of Chiaravalle is not a cardinal and is excluded.

decisions.finding: The triggering condition of clause 5 is not kept as rf:condition; rv:Petitioner for the king considered.
decisions.reason: The admonition and excommunication apply only to one who 'sich anmaßen sollte, die Gerechtsame des Reiches (iusticiam et honorem regni) zu mißachten'; this is a condition in exact wording and is lost. The king stays rv:Beneficiary: rv:Petitioner means the one at whose request the act happens, while the promise itself is not made at his request; 'auf Ersuchen des Königs' is already kept as condition of the future admonition.

regests.lead: Friedrich hält einen Hoftag .
regests.text: Friedrich hält einen Hoftag . Legaten Eugens III., der Kardinalpriestcr Bernhard von S. Clemente und der Kardinaldiakon Gregor von S. Angelo, erscheinen bei Hofe. Die beiden Bürger von Lodi, Albernardus Alamanus und Magister Homobonus, die auf Bitten des Bischofs Hermann von Konstanz die Stadt Konstanz aufgesucht haben, klagen vor König Friedrich und den Fürsten über die Unterdrückung durch die Mailänder, besonders über die gewaltsame Verlegung eines Marktes, worauf Friedrich durch seinen Kanzler (Arnold) ein Schreiben an die Mailänder ausfertigen läßt (vgl. Regg. 168 und 192). Friedrich wird, nachdem schon vorher die Erzbischöfe und Bischöfe auf einer Synode darüber beraten haben, vor den päpstlichen Legaten und Bischof Hermann von Konstanz von Adela, seiner ersten Gemahlin, der Tochter des Markgrafen Diepold von Vohburg, wegen zu naher Verwandtschaft im Chor (des Domes) von Konstanz geschieden.

commentary.t: Zu den genannten Ereignissen vgl. Simonsfeld, Jahrbücher 156 ff. Zur Möglichkeit eines Kontaktes des Bischofs von Konstanz mit Lodi vgl. Weiss, Die Konstanzer Bischöfe (Konstanzer Geschichtsu. Rechtsquellen 20, 1975) 90 f. und zur Lodesaner Gesandtschaft Caretta, Le cinque ambascerie lodigiane, Arch. stor. Lodigiano ser. II a. VIII (1960) 57 f. Über den Mißerfolg der Legation Sichers in Mailand berichtet Otto Morena, a. a. O. 9 f, (vgl. Reg.
). Datierbar ist nur die Klage der Bürger von Lodi mit dem 4. März (
die Mercurii capitis ieiunii
... Morena, a. a. O. 3, Z. 21 f.). Zur Annullierung von Friedrichs erster Ehe, die er vor seiner Wahl zum König geschlossen hatte (Reg.

), vgl. Rundnagel, Ehescheidung (FS. R. Holtzmann = Hist. Stud. 238, 1933) 145 ff. und Güterbock, Otto von St. Blasien (FS. R. Holtzmann = Hist. Stud. 238, 1933) 204 f. Vielleicht bezieht sich ein Eintrag im Necrologium Isnense, MG. Necrologia I, 177 zu Februar 19 (
Adelhaidis regina, benefactrix
) mit Anm. 1, auf die erste Gemahlin König Friedrichs.
Verbesserungen und Zusätze(2011):

Zur Trennung der ersten Ehe Friedrich Barbarossas von Vohburg vgl. zuletzt Hlawitschka, Auflösung der Ehe, DA 61 (2005) 509–536, der nachweist, dass Adela die Enkeltochter Judiths, der Tochter Kaiser Heinrichs III. und Schwester Heinrichs IV. sowie Witwe nach König Salomon von Ungarn, und ihres Gemahls Herzog Wladislav I. (Hermann) von Polen war und demzufolge mit ihrem Mann, Friedrich tatsächlich im kanonischen Gradverhältnis 3:4 verwandt war, was von der Kurie nicht akzeptiert werden konnte. Hlawitschka bestimmt damit auch den Quellenwert der durch Wibald von Stablo überlieferten Consanguinitätstafel neu.

transmission.t: Zum Hoftag vgl. Otto von St. Blasien, ed. Hofmeister, MG. SS rer. Germ, in us. schol. 10. Epp. Wibaldi, ed. Jaffé, Mon. Corb. 548 n
409, JL. 9696 (Schreiben Eugens III. an Wibald von 1153 Februar 8). In DF. I. 52 wird die Zusage des Königs in die Hand des päpstlichen Legaten erwähnt.
erfolgte auch die Scheidung; Ann. s. Aegid. Brunsvic. exc., MG. SS XXX/1, 15; Ann. Palid., MG. SS XVI, 88; Ann. Magdeburg., MG. SS XVI, 191:

lines.text: wegen der von ihnen gewaltsam vorgenommenen Verlegung eines Marktes der Lodesaner

unresolved.text: 'ihnen' in 'von ihnen gewaltsam vorgenommenen Verlegung' read as the Milanese (Respondent); grammatically it could refer to the complainants.
The Lodesaner have no register candidate; kept only in the label of the market right, not as an actor.

gaps.text: No act type for a forcible seizure or relocation of a right (usurpation); the relocation of the market and the compulsion of the Laudenses (Latin quote) are not recorded as own factoids.
The content of the mandate is not stated in German; the Latin quote describes the wrong and is not used as evidence.
The genitive 'Marktes der Lodesaner' would suggest a right holding, not recorded because it rests only on the complaint.
No relation for an act occasioned by another act (mandate upon complaint).

The Latin narratio (removal from the burgus Placentinus, relocation to an uninhabited open field, compulsion of the Lodesans) can only be kept as an exact literal; the contract has no property for the content of a mandate or the former and new location of a moved market.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22795:complaints
findings.description: The Lodesans, whose market was moved and who were compelled to hold it in the open field, appear in no reference. They are the injured party of the dispute and the holders of the market right named by the passage. No community candidate exists in the packet, so a regest-local group would be needed.
findings.proposal: Add a local group urn:regesta:actor:22795:local:lodesaner (crm:E74_Group, label 'Lodesaner') as rv:Beneficiary of the complaint, or a StateFactoid rv:RightHolding with the Lodesans as rv:RightHolder of the market.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22795:mandate
findings.description: rf:refersToAct links the mandate to the complaints. The contract defines refersToAct for a later confirmation or assurance referring to an earlier act; a mandate issued upon complaints is a response, not a confirmation. The link is useful but stretches the definition.
findings.proposal: Keep the link but record that the contract lacks an 'occasioned by' relation, or use rf:ground with the exact wording 'nach Klagen der Bürger Albernardus Alamanus und Magister Homobonus von Lodi' on the mandate.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22795:complaints
findings.description: The Milanese are referenced as rv:Respondent via the pronoun 'ihnen'. The German sentence is grammatically ambiguous; the reading rests on the Latin quotation and on the mandate's address. It is plausible but is an interpretive step an expert should confirm.
findings.proposal: No change; mark the pronoun resolution for expert review.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22795:market-lodesaner
findings.description: The market is typed crm:E30_Right with rv:Market. The passage speaks of moving a market (an event and place), not of a market privilege. The right reading is defensible but not stated by the regest.
findings.proposal: Consider crm:E18_Physical_Thing or a place for the market itself, or keep the right with an editorial note.

decisions.finding: The Lodesaner, whose market was moved, appear in no reference; a local group as rv:Beneficiary or a RightHolding state is proposed.
decisions.reason: The passage names them only in the genitive of the concerned object ('Verlegung eines Marktes der Lodesaner'), and that wording is kept in the label of urn:regesta:22795:market-lodesaner. The regest does not say the complaint is made on their behalf (Beneficiary would be a reading), and a RightHolding state would rest on the right-reading of the market that the same review questions. The claimants who are named, the two citizens of Lodi, are referenced.

decisions.finding: rf:refersToAct links the mandate to the complaints although refersToAct is defined for confirmations and assurances.
decisions.reason: The definition of rf:refersToAct names confirmation and assurance as examples ('such as'), not as an exhaustive list; a mandate issued 'nach Klagen der Bürger ...' refers to the earlier act reported by the same regest and implies no date.

decisions.finding: The Milanese as rv:Respondent rest on resolving the pronoun 'ihnen'.
decisions.reason: The reading is supported by the address of the mandate ('Friedrich erläßt an die Mailänder') and by the Latin narratio ('abstulerunt ... constituerunt ... compulerunt'), and rf:nameInSource "ihnen" keeps the pronoun visible. The reviewer proposes no change.

decisions.finding: The market is typed crm:E30_Right with rv:Market although the passage speaks of moving a market.
decisions.reason: The guidelines allow a right as concerned object, and the label keeps the source wording 'Marktes der Lodesaner'. Retyping it as a thing would be another reading of equal strength, not a correction.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22796:confirmation
findings.description: The confirmation points with rf:refersToAct to the oath and the promise as if it confirmed them. The regest gives them as preconditions completed before the issuance ('nachdem ... vollzogen worden sind'); the object of the issuance is the treaty text only. The temporal precondition is thereby turned into an object of confirmation.
findings.proposal: Keep rf:refersToAct only to urn:regesta:22796:treaty-negotiation; record the precondition on the confirmation as rf:qualifier (or rf:condition) with the exact wording 'nachdem die noch ausständigen Rechtshandlungen ... vollzogen worden sind' and report the missing precondition relation as a model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22796:treaty-negotiation
findings.description: The treaty factoid names only the negotiators as one functional actor. 'beiderseitigen' marks two sides, Friedrich and Pope Eugen, who are the parties of the treaty; neither is referenced, so the earlier act is detached from its parties.
findings.proposal: Add references to Friedrich and urn:regesta:actor:RI004-002-E000589 with rv:Participant (or rv:Negotiator for the sides) on the treaty factoid, supported by the evidence 'Friedrich verbrieft Papst Eugen (III.)'.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22796:treaty-negotiation
findings.description: A formulated treaty text is more than a negotiation, while rv:Negotiation explicitly denies a conclusion. The vocabulary has no type for an agreement or treaty; Negotiation is the most cautious available choice.
findings.proposal: Keep for this contract; record the missing agreement/treaty act type.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22796:oath
findings.description: Friedrich carries rv:Grantor in an oath sworn by a ministerial on the king's soul. The king is the principal bound by the oath, not a grantor; the vocabulary offers no principal role.
findings.proposal: Consider rv:Obligor for the king or record the missing principal role as a model gap.

decisions.finding: The confirmation points with rf:refersToAct to the oath and the promise, which the regest gives as completed preconditions, not as objects of the confirmation.
decisions.reason: The object of 'Friedrich verbrieft Papst Eugen (III.) den Wortlaut des ... Vertrages' is the treaty text only; the oath and the promise stand in the temporal clause 'nachdem die noch ausständigen Rechtshandlungen ... vollzogen worden sind'. rf:refersToAct to them reads as if the charter confirmed them. Their temporal relation is already kept by rf:qualifier "nachdem" on both factoids, so no new literal is needed.

decisions.finding: The treaty factoid names only the negotiators; the two sides marked by 'beiderseitigen', Friedrich and Pope Eugen, are not referenced.
decisions.reason: 'des von den beiderseitigen Unterhändlern formulierten Vertrages' marks two sides, and the same sentence names the two parties between whom the charter passes ('Friedrich verbrieft Papst Eugen (III.)'). Their exact function in the treaty is not stated, so only rv:Participant is safe; rv:Negotiator stays with the negotiators.

decisions.finding: rv:Negotiation denies a conclusion, but a formulated treaty is more than a negotiation; no agreement type exists.
decisions.reason: The vocabulary has no act type for an agreement or treaty; rv:Negotiation is the most cautious available type for 'formulierten Vertrages'. No correction.

decisions.finding: Friedrich carries rv:Grantor in an oath sworn by a ministerial on the king's soul.
decisions.reason: In 'die Eidesleistung eines Reichsministerialen in anima regis' the king neither transfers, confirms, grants nor enacts, so rv:Grantor misstates his part. rv:Obligor would add the legal reading that the oath binds the king; the safe fix is rv:Participant, and the principal role is recorded as a model gap.

commentary.t: Das Fehlen des Namens des Bischofs von Chur muß nicht unbedingt auf den Kopisten zurückgehen, da wir solchen Fällen auch bei Originalen begegnen. Wien 210/3 (1930) 7 ff., der die geringfügigen Änderungen im Text gegenüber dem Vorvertrag (Reg.

regests.text: Friedrich bestätigt dem Abt und Grafen Anselm von Bobbio auf seine Bitten und die Intervention des Erzbischofs, obersten Rates und Erzkanzlers Heinrich von Mainz, des Erzbischofs Arnold von Köln, des Bischofs Ortlieb von Basel, des Markgrafen Hermann von Baden und des Grafen Ulrich von Lenzburg und gemäß den Privilegien seiner Vorgänger Lothar und seines Sohnes Ludwig, Karlmann und seines Bruders Karl, Otto I., II. und III., Heinrich IV. und Konrad II. (III.) die Grafschaft Bobbio innerhalb der angegebenen Grenzen mit allen Rechten und Zugehörungen, den jährlichen Empfang von 60 Pfund Silber vom Hof, die Freiheit von der Leistung des Treueides und alle päpstlichen Privilegien. Z.: die Intervenienten und die Bischöfe Hermann von Konstanz, Gunther von Speyer, Konrad von Worms, Adelgot von Chur, Anselm von Havelberg, Konrad von Augsburg, Ardicio von Como und die päpstlichen Legaten, Kardinalpresbyter Bernhard von S. Clemente und Kardinaldiakon Gregor von S. Angelo, Herzog Rudolf (statt Welf) von Spoleto und Markgraf von Tuszien und die Äbte Fridelo von der Reichenau und Wibald von Corvey. -Arnoldus canc, vice Henrici Maguntini archiep. et archicanc. ; unter Verwendung von DDF. I. 53 (Reg. 170/VU. I), Ka. III. 182 (VU. II), Wido (Schiaparelli, I Diplomi di Guido e Lamberto 49 no 20/VU. III), O. I. 412 (VU. IV), O. III. 335 (VU. V) und K. III. *94 (VU. VI) abgefaßt. Si sanctam dei .

commentary.t: Das vorliegende Spurium ist das letzte in der Reihe der Bobbieser Fälschungen, vgl. Schieffer zu DL. I. 144 und Hausmann zu DK. III. *94, deren Entstehung mit Scheffer-Boichorst, Zur Gesch. d. 12. u. 13. Jh. 257 ff. und Hirsch, Die gefälschten Diplome (Papsttum und Kaisertum = FS. P. Kehr, 1926) 347 ff. in das spätere 13. bzw. zu Anfang des 14. Jh. zu setzen ist. Buzzi, CD. di Bobbio 3, 29 ff. und Manaresi im Boll. stor. Piacentino 22 (1927) 175 setzen sie in die Zeit vor 1172, doch sprechen Zusammenhänge mit anderen Fälschungsgruppen und auch die Verwendung des Begriffs
merum et mixtum imperium
für den späteren Zeitansatz. - Über das nur aus der vorliegenden Erwähnung bekannte Deperditum Heinrichs IV. vgl. Gawlik, DH. IV. *517.

Z.: die päpstlichen Legaten Kardinalpriester Bernhard und Kardinaldiakon Gregor, die Bischöfe Anselm von Havelberg, Otto von Freising, Wichmann von Zeitz, Gebhard von Würzburg und Konrad von Augsburg, die Markgrafen Albrecht (Adalbert) von Sachsen, Otakar von Steier, die Grafen Rudolf von Ramsberg, Friedrich von Beichlingen, Markward von Grumbach; von den Leuten von Como waren anwesend: Iohannes Calignus, der Richter Albert, der Peregrin genannt wird, Iohannes Sescalcus, Aliprandus de Plazola, Arnaldus de Ripa und Martinus de Castello, ein Verwandter (nepos) des Bischofs (Ardicio); als Vertreter Chiavennas waren anwesend: die zwei erwähnten Wiberti (Guibertus vero Crassus et Guibertus Porcus), Manfredus de Landran, Soldanus, Karolus und der Priester Marchisius de Balerna . - Arnoldus canc. vice Maguntini archiep. et archicanc. ; verfaßt und wohl auch geschrieben von A II. C; das Original war mit einem SI. versehen. Imperii nostri nos .

III. 149 (VU.), bis auf das von A II. D stammende Monogramm, von einem Empfängerschreiber mundiert, der auch DF. I. 57 (Reg. 177) schrieb; SI. 1. Si antecessorum nostrorum .

gaps.text: The content of Konrad's earlier 'Verfügungen' is only implied by 'in Erneuerung'; the earlier act is typed rv:Enactment without rf:concerns, since the regest does not state which items Konrad granted.

rf:amount cannot be bound to an individual thing: '20 Solidi' belongs to the two Hufen, '4 Solidi' to the mill, both sit on one donation factoid. The amounts are yields (Ertrag), not prices, and the model has no property for revenue yield.
'als Seelgerät' (pious purpose) has no dedicated property; kept as rf:qualifier on the confirmation.
rf:amount attaches to the factoid, not to a concerned thing, so several amounts in one act cannot be bound to their items.
No property for the purpose of an act (Seelgerät, pro remedio animae) distinct from rf:ground.

corrections.text: rdfs:label of <urn:regesta:22803:hufen> changed to "zweier Hufen mit dem Ertrag von 20 Solidi".
rdfs:label of <urn:regesta:22803:muehle> changed to "einer Mühle mit 4 Solidi Ertrag".

Factoid urn:regesta:22803:donation left unchanged, including both rf:amount literals and its producer, because only the labels of the concerned things changed and the instruction keeps the factoid unchanged.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22803:donation
findings.description: Both amounts sit as literals on one donation factoid that concerns two hides, a mill and Roßdorf, so the reading that 20 Solidi belong to the hides and 4 Solidi to the mill is lost. The contract could keep it by two donation factoids, one per item, each with its own amount.
findings.proposal: Split into a donation of 'zweier Hufen' with rf:amount 'mit dem Ertrag von 20 Solidi' and a donation of 'einer Mühle' with rf:amount 'mit 4 Solidi Ertrag' concerning Roßdorf, both rf:partOf or linked to the confirmation.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22803:konrad-verfuegungen
findings.description: Konrad III's earlier act carries only the grantor. The regest says Friedrich renews these dispositions in favour of Fredelsloh, so the stift as recipient and the chapel, protection and advocacy as concerned items rest on the same clause. Typing it rv:Enactment rather than rv:Grant is cautious and defensible.
findings.proposal: Optionally add the Fredelsloh community as rv:Recipient and rf:concerns to the three items; keep the act undated.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22803:donation
findings.description: The regest marks the donation as Friedrich's own addition beyond the renewal ('fügt selber ... hinzu'). rf:partOf the confirmation is admissible as a secondary act, but it blurs that this is a new grant, not part of what is confirmed.
findings.proposal: Consider dropping rf:partOf and keeping the donation as an independent act factoid of the same charter.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22803:confirmation
findings.description: 'als Seelgerät' states the pious purpose of the act rather than a type or time qualification; rf:ground would fit it better. The exclusivity of royal advocacy is kept only inside the right label and evidence, not as a literal.
findings.proposal: Move 'als Seelgerät' to rf:ground; optionally add rf:exception 'preter nos nostrosque successores reges seu imperatores' to the advocacy provision.

decisions.finding: Both amounts sit on one donation factoid, so the binding of 20 Solidi to the hides and 4 Solidi to the mill is lost; a split into two donations is proposed.
decisions.reason: The finding holds: 'zweier Hufen mit dem Ertrag von 20 Solidi, sowie einer Mühle mit 4 Solidi Ertrag' binds each yield to its item. Splitting one stated act into two factoids would change the unit of the act to work around the model (rf:amount attaches to the factoid). The safe fix keeps one donation and binds the yields in the labels of the concerned things, which the guidelines require to be in the source's words.

decisions.finding: rf:partOf the confirmation blurs that the donation is Friedrich's own addition.
decisions.reason: rf:partOf is defined for 'a provision or secondary act belonging to a main act of the same regest'; the donation is added in the same charter ('fügt selber ... hinzu'), and rf:qualifier "selber" keeps the addition visible.

decisions.finding: Move 'als Seelgerät' to rf:ground; add rf:exception 'preter nos nostrosque successores reges seu imperatores'.
decisions.reason: 'als Seelgerät' qualifies the kind of transfer rather than giving a reason, and its exact wording is kept; the contract has no purpose property. 'preter nos ...' is not an exception to the confirmation but the content of the exclusive royal advocacy, kept in the right's label and the evidence.

decisions.finding: Optionally add Fredelsloh as recipient and the three items as concerned objects of Konrad III's earlier dispositions.
decisions.reason: 'in Erneuerung der Verfügungen Konrads (III.)' does not state what Konrad disposed or for whom; carrying the present items back to the earlier act would infer its content.

gaps.text: No act type for subordinating an abbey to a provost (Unterstellung); typed rv:Grant with rf:qualifier 'unterstellt'.
No right type for a free election right (Propstwahl); typed with top concept rv:ChurchRights.
Konrad's earlier act ('wie dies schon ... tat') gets no recipient, since 'dies' leaves open whether Konrad subordinated the abbey to Bertram himself.
The reservation of the Vogtei is recorded both as its own Enactment factoid and as rf:exception; the model has no reservation act type.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22804:konrad-grant
findings.description: 'wie dies schon Konrad (III.) ... tat' refers to the same subordination, so Bertram or the provost of Fredelsloh as recipient is implied but not stated by name for the earlier act. Leaving the recipient out is cautious and acceptable.
findings.proposal: No change required; optionally note in the qualifier that the earlier act repeats the subordination.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22804:subordination
findings.description: rf:qualifier 'unterstellt' repeats the verb instead of qualifying type or time. Harmless but adds nothing the factoid type does not say.
findings.proposal: Drop the qualifier or keep it only if the subordination needs to be distinguished from an ordinary grant.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22804:propstwahl
findings.description: The right of free election is typed with the top concept rv:ChurchRights because no election right exists; the nuns are rv:Beneficiary, where rv:RightHolder would also be defensible.
findings.proposal: No change within the contract; record the missing election-right concept as a model gap.

decisions.finding: Drop rf:qualifier 'unterstellt', which repeats the verb.
decisions.reason: The vocabulary has no subordination type, so the exact verb distinguishes 'Friedrich unterstellt die Reichsabtei Hilwartshausen ... dem Propst Bertram' from an ordinary grant; it is harmless and exact.

decisions.finding: No right type for a right of election (Propstwahl, Vogtwahl); no act type for subordination.
decisions.reason: rv:RightTypes lacks an election right and rv:ActTypes a subordination; the extractions use the closest broader concepts. No correction.

regests.lead: Friedrich hält zu Pfingsten einen Hoftag .
regests.text: Friedrich hält zu Pfingsten einen Hoftag . Herzog Heinrich von Bayern weigert sich, über die Klage des gleichfalls anwesenden Herzogs Heinrich von Sachsen um das Herzogtum Bayern zu verhandeln. Friedrich läßt Erzbischof Heinrich von Mainz (Otto von Freising: ... pro distractione aecclesiae suae frequenter correptum nec correctum, ... ; Ann. s. Disibodi: ... ex praecepto Eugenii ; Ann. Palid.: ... ob inutilitatem...) sowie die Bischöfe Burchard von Eichstätt (Otto von Freising: ... senio gravem, de inutilitate causantes, ...), Bernhard von Hildesheim (Ann. Palid.: ... quia sacerdotale ministerium plenius exequi non poterat, ...) und Heinrich von Minden (Chron. reg. Col.: ... dum propter clericum quendam, qui in civitate a suis, ipso consentiente ut dicebatur, cecatus fuerat, expurgare se non posset, multis pertesus adversitatibus...) durch die Kardinallegaten absetzen und seinen Kanzler Arnold durch anwesende Mitglieder des Klerus und des Volkes zu Heinrichs Nachfolger in Mainz wählen.

gaps.text: No act type for a deposition from office: the deposition of Archbishop Heinrich of Mainz and the bishops Burchard of Eichstätt, Bernhard of Hildesheim and Heinrich of Minden by the cardinal legates was not extracted; the chronicle quotations giving reasons are commentary-like and were not used as rf:ground.
No act type or property for a respondent's refusal to negotiate a claim; the Dispute factoid keeps 'weigert sich' only in its evidence.
Election is typed rv:Appointment; Friedrich, who causes the election ('läßt ... wählen'), is given rv:Grantor and the electors rv:Participant, since no elector or initiator role exists.
The Hoftag is out of scope and not extracted.
No act type for deposition from office (Absetzung).
No role for an actor who causes an act carried out by others (Friedrich läßt ... absetzen / wählen) and no elector role.
No act type or qualifier for refusal to negotiate or to submit to a court.

findings.description: Friedrich has the cardinal legates depose Archbishop Heinrich of Mainz and the bishops Burchard of Eichstätt, Bernhard of Hildesheim and Heinrich of Minden. This is the core legal act of the record and is absent; the regest also gives grounds for each deposition in quoted source wording. The vocabulary has no deposition act type, so a fully correct factoid is not possible, but the prelates' office holding, the cardinal legates as functional actors and the quoted grounds as rf:ground could have been recorded, and the omission should at least be reported.
findings.proposal: Once a deposition type exists, add one act factoid per deposed prelate with Friedrich as causing actor, 'die Kardinallegaten' as rf:FunctionalActor, the prelate as affected party and the quoted reasons (for example 'ob inutilitatem') as rf:ground; until then report the passage as a model gap.
